english: Esus gifted the Svartalfar, the winter court side of the elven civil war, with a breed of large panthers that were strong mounts as well as powerful attackers in their own right. A Nyxkin is a Svartalfar warrior who is bound to one of these panthers. The bond is so great that if either side dies, the other will as well. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 埃苏斯赐予斯瓦塔尔法——精灵内战中冬之宫廷一方——一种巨型黑豹,它们既是强健的坐骑,自身也是凶悍的攻击者。豹骑兵(Nyxkin)是与其中一头黑豹缔结契约的斯瓦塔尔法战士。这种羁绊如此深重,以致一方死去,另一方也随之丧命。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: A Minotaur is a tall humanoid with the head of a bull. They are vigilante guardians, and outside of being unable to resist a fight they mind they are reliable soldiers. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 牛头人是身形高大、长着公牛头颅的类人生物。他们是自发行侠的守卫者,除了无法拒绝一场找上门的争斗之外,都是可靠的士兵。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: Esus traveled to the dark hell of Agares only to find it deserted and in ruin. Disliking such a barren world Esus breathed life into the dust and a people half-formed appeared, shadows of a lost people. These people he named the Mistforms and he brought them into Erebus. Mistforms can attack people, but if left alone typically avoid any contact with men and go through their own patterns and habits with little regard for the surrounding world. These habits seem to have little purpose and many suspect they are dreaming they are in a world that no longer exists. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 埃苏斯远赴阿加雷斯那阴暗的地狱,却只见其荒废倾颓、渺无人烟。埃苏斯厌恶如此贫瘠的世界,便向尘埃吹入生息,于是一群半成形的生灵浮现——那是某个失落民族的残影。他将这些生灵命名为雾魅(Mistform),并把他们带入埃瑞布斯。雾魅能攻击人,但若无人打扰,通常会回避与人接触,依着自己的规律与习性行事,几乎不理会周遭的世界。这些习性似乎毫无目的,许多人疑心他们正梦着一个早已不复存在的世界。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: The Stygian Guard are the silent servants of Hastur. They exhibit no attempts at communication and little evidence of thought outside of their ability to ruthlessly follow commands. When they aren't being commanded they seek out pools or other bodies of water and sink unmoving to the bottom unless disturbed. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 冥河守卫(Stygian Guard)是哈斯塔沉默的仆从。他们全无沟通的意图,除了冷酷执行命令的本领外,也几乎不见任何思想的迹象。无人差遣时,他们便寻向水潭或别的水体,一动不动地沉入水底,除非被惊扰。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: A mix of eagles and lions, griffons make loyal mounts and pets to those who are able to tame them. They enjoy dangerous flying so less reckless riders will probably only ride a griffon once. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 狮鹫融合了鹰与狮,对能驯服它们的人而言,是忠诚的坐骑与伙伴。它们酷爱惊险的飞行,所以不那么鲁莽的骑手,大概一生只会骑一次狮鹫。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: Sea Serpents can grow to be large enough to swallow entire ships whole and they release thousands of eggs during their mating cycles. It is only their frequent clashes with each other and the lack of food in their environment that keeps their numbers under control. -- The Bestiary of Erebus
chinese: 海蛇能长到大得足以将整艘船囫囵吞下,交配期一次便产下成千上万枚卵。全靠它们彼此间频繁的争斗,以及生境中食物的匮乏,其数量才得以受制。——《埃瑞布斯生物志》

english: [ICON_BULLET]Will abandon players that do not have the right State Religion, Civic, or Leader type
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]将抛弃不具备相应国教、政策或领袖类型的玩家

english: Use Pyre Zombies as expendable front line troops. They are stronger than Men-At Arms, if you include their fire damage, and when defeated will explode, damaging all units (enemy and friendly) within a tile of the zombie. They require both Fire and Death mana to train, and are not available to players of the Good alignment. They are Undead units, and so are vulnerable to the Undead Slaying promotion and the Destroy Undead Spell. The Overcouncil's resolution against Death mana blocks its members from training these units.
chinese: 将火焚还魂者用作可消耗的前线部队。若把火焰伤害算在内,他们比持械步兵更强,被击败时会爆炸,伤及僵尸一格范围内的所有单位(敌我皆然)。训练他们需同时具备炎之能量与死亡能量,善良阵营的玩家无法使用。他们属于不死单位,因而易受「猎杀不死」晋升与「消灭不死」法术的克制。上议会针对死亡能量的决议会阻止其成员训练这类单位。

english: Magnadine's horsemanship is legendary, but he is more renowned for leading mercenaries to wealth and glory. Sellswords often rip up contracts to join his company. His charisma inspires loyalty that is worth far more than gold.
chinese: 麦格纳丹的马术堪称传奇,但他更以率领雇佣兵走向财富与荣耀而闻名。佣兵们常撕毁契约,只为加入他的队伍。他的魅力所激发的忠诚,远比黄金珍贵。

english: Baron Duin Halfmorn was a fearsome warlord during the Age of Magic. He hosted lavish banquets after his victories, where he and his generals feasted on the bodies of the vanquished. In time his generals' ambition grew to match his own. They turned on him in a bloody civil war. Duin won the war but lost his empire; he sat alone in the end, feasting on his generals' corpses. [PARAGRAPH:1]Ancient legends tell of Duin's cruelty, cannibalism, and worship of Camulos, but they do not relate his darkest secret. The God of Strife rewarded the Baron's devotion with the curse of Lycanthropy, yet let him control his bestial nature well enough to keep it hidden from the world. Duin was not the first werewolf, nor last, but was the greatest. [PARAGRAPH:1]The horrific Duin did die, as all mortals do, but would not be allowed to rest in peace. His soul fought for centuries in Hell, before returning to the world of the living. In a time of dire need, desperate mages performed rites to bring back the greatest, most feared general of history. [PARAGRAPH:1]Mortal magic may resurrect only the dead whose spirits linger in Erebus. Without divine intervention, it can never draw a soul back from beyond the plane. Camulos sent the Baron back on a mission to revive lycanthropy. Werewolves went extinct during the Age of Ice. Every infection in the current epidemic can be clearly traced back to Halfmorn himself. His true nature is now known, and rightly feared.
chinese: 哈夫蒙男爵杜因是魔法纪元中令人闻风丧胆的军阀。每逢大捷,他便大摆筵席,与麾下将领一同啖食败者的尸身。日久,将领们的野心渐渐与他并驾齐驱。他们在一场血腥内战中反叛了他。杜因赢了战争,却失了帝国;到头来他孤身独坐,啖食着将领们的尸体。[PARAGRAPH:1]古老的传说讲述杜因的残暴、食人与对卡穆洛斯的崇拜,却不曾道出他最阴暗的秘密。这位纷争之神以狼化之诅咒回报男爵的虔诚,又让他能足够地驾驭那兽性,将其隐匿于世人之外。杜因不是第一个狼人,也非最后一个,却是最强大的一个。[PARAGRAPH:1]恐怖的杜因终究如所有凡人一般死去,却不得安息。他的灵魂在地狱中厮杀了数个世纪,方才重返生者的世界。在一个危急存亡之际,走投无路的法师们施行仪式,唤回了史上最伟大、最令人畏惧的将领。[PARAGRAPH:1]凡间的魔法只能复活那些魂魄仍逗留于埃瑞布斯的死者。若无神明干预,它绝无法将灵魂从位面之外拉回。是卡穆洛斯派男爵回返,授以复兴狼化症的使命。狼人在冰之纪元中已然绝迹。如今这场瘟疫里的每一例感染,都能清晰追溯至哈夫蒙本人。他的真实本性现已为人所知,也理应为人所惧。

english: Duin is now a melee unit instead of a beast, so he cannot so easily be captured by Beastmasters, but he is still a werewolf. Living units that he slays, or even those that slay him, risk becoming infected with Lycanthropy. He is the Alpha Werewolf, who can dominate other lycanthropes to make them join his pack. Ravenous Werewolves are usually born rebellious, but they would not dare rebel against the Baron Halfmorn.
chinese: 杜因如今是近战单位而非野兽,因此不再那么容易被兽王捕获,但他仍是狼人。被他杀死的活体单位——甚至杀死他的单位——都有被狼化症感染之虞。他是狼王(Alpha Werewolf),能支配其他狼化者、使其加入自己的族群。饥渴狼人生来多半桀骜不驯,却绝不敢反叛哈夫蒙男爵。

english: [TAB]The Frost Speakers, disciples of Mulcarn, were tolerated by most nations in the Age of Magic. They would pledge allegiance to no sovereign, but they did not speak sedition, either. Well beyond stoic in their demeanor, followers of Winter lost passion of all sorts. Initiation to this order involved bathing in icy waters overnight. Those who survived the 'baptism' usually had their outlook changed dramatically by it, without need of theological debate. [PARAGRAPH:1]These cold men now lead the armies of their god. Slow to adapt to their enemies' tactics, their strength lies in unflinching rationality, carrying out their plans unhindered by fear, ambition, or personal attachment. They will patch up wounded soldiers with divine aid of their god-king, but evidence suggests their compassion is something to be desired. More than once Amurite recon patrols have found badly wounded Illian warriors buried in the snow--occasionally still breathing.
chinese: [TAB]霜语者是穆尔卡恩的门徒,在魔法纪元中为大多数国家所容忍。他们不向任何君主宣誓效忠,却也不散播叛乱之言。冬之信徒的举止远不止于坚忍——他们丧失了一切激情。加入这一教团的入会礼,是在冰水中通宵沐浴。熬过这场「洗礼」的人,往往无需神学辩论,人生观便已被它彻底改变。[PARAGRAPH:1]这些冷酷之人如今统领着他们神明的军队。他们迟于适应敌人的战术,力量却在于毫不动摇的理性——推行计划时,不为恐惧、野心或私人情感所扰。他们会以其神王的神力救治伤兵,但种种迹象表明,他们的怜悯实在乏善可陈。阿姆莱特的侦察队不止一次在雪中发现身负重伤、被埋起来的伊利安战士——偶尔还在喘息。

english: [TAB]The protection of our national wealth demands that we restrict our trading, so as to prevent other nations from profiting from the work our faithful citizens have done. Any foreign power is a potential adversary, a vicious predator probing for weaknesses and biding its time. To hand it weapons and tools is to invite disaster. [PARAGRAPH:1]-Arian Kothrax, High Councilor, Steward of Inequity[PARAGRAPH:2]Trade has ever been the extinguisher of war, the eradicator of prejudice, the diffuser of knowledge. [PARAGRAPH:1]Is it not evident that the impoverishment and dependence of labor are abnormal conditions resulting from restrictions and usurpations, and that instead of accepting protection, what labor should demand is freedom. That those who advocate any extension of freedom choose to go no further than suits their own special purpose is no reason why freedom itself should be distrusted. [PARAGRAPH:1]-Henry George
chinese: [TAB]为护卫我们国家的财富,必须限制通商,以免他国从我们忠实公民的劳作中获利。任何外邦皆是潜在的敌手,是伺机而动、四处试探弱点的凶恶掠食者。将武器与工具交到它手中,无异于招致灾祸。[PARAGRAPH:1]——阿里安·科斯拉克斯,高级议员,不义之管家[PARAGRAPH:2]贸易从来都是战争的熄灭者、偏见的根除者、知识的传播者。[PARAGRAPH:1]难道还不明显吗:劳动者的贫困与依附乃是限制与僭夺所致的反常境况;劳动者不该接受什么保护,而应索求自由。倡导扩展自由者只肯走到合乎自己特定目的之处、不肯再进一步,这绝非理由去怀疑自由本身。[PARAGRAPH:1]——亨利·乔治

english: A fire ship or fireship, used in the days of wooden rowed or sailing ships, was a ship filled with combustibles, deliberately set on fire and steered (or, where possible, allowed to drift) into an enemy fleet, in order to destroy ships, or to create panic and make the enemy break formation. Ships used as fire ships were usually old and worn out or purpose-built inexpensive vessels. An explosion ship or hellburner was a variation on the fire ship, intended to cause damage by blowing up in proximity to enemy ships.
chinese: 火船,在木桨船或帆船的时代所用,是一种装满可燃物、被刻意点燃并驶向(或在可能时任其漂向)敌方舰队的船只,用以摧毁船舰,或制造恐慌、使敌军阵形溃乱。用作火船的船只通常是老旧破损的,或专门建造的廉价船只。爆破船(又称地狱燃烧者)是火船的一种变体,意在于敌船近旁引爆以造成损伤。

english: Fire Ships are cheap expendable alternatives to more conventional naval combat, and a good way to get rid of otherwise obsolete vessels. When defeated they will explode, damaging all units (enemy and friendly) nearby. They can be produded through either arcane or mundane means, using either Fire Mana or Gunpowder.
chinese: 火船是常规海战之外廉价而可弃的替代品,也是处置那些本已过时之船只的好办法。被击败时它们会爆炸,伤及附近所有单位(敌我皆然)。它们可经由秘法或凡俗手段建造——使用炎之能量或火药皆可。

english: Sarabride outlaws magic entirely and has an army of witch hunters specifically trained to kill mages. She also has a formidable force of cannons and steampunk style riflemen and pistoleers. Unknown to most, a small group of true angels of Bhall serve, guard and protect her.
chinese: 萨拉布莱德彻底取缔魔法,并拥有一支专为杀死法师而训练的猎巫者大军。她还坐拥一支强大的力量——加农炮,以及蒸汽朋克风格的火枪手与手枪手。鲜为人知的是,一小群巴尔的真正天使正为她效力、守卫并护佑着她。

english: No mortals are better trained than Witch Hunters for the task of protecting society from rogue sorcerers. Unfortunately, they tend to be cruel and corrupt. Even honest ones are often overzealous, failing to distinguish between good and evil uses of magic and more willing to condemn a hundred innocents than let one guilty party go free. Employing them especially angers those leaders whose political power depends upon arcane might.
chinese: 再没有哪种凡人比猎巫者更擅长守护社会、抵御邪恶术士。可惜的是,他们往往残忍而堕落。即便清白之辈也常常过分狂热,分辨不出魔法的善用与恶用,宁可错杀一百无辜,也不肯放过一个有罪之人。雇用他们尤其会激怒那些政治权力仰赖秘法之力的领袖。
下议会城市归属授权令

english: Enlist the Nightwatch: A Nightwatch unit is provided to every member who pays, and the state religion requirement for training them is waived.
chinese: 招募守夜人:每位付款的成员都将获得一个守夜人单位,且训练他们的国教要求予以豁免。

english: Enlist the Radiant Guard: A Radiant Guard unit is provided to every member, and the state religion requirement for training them is waived.
chinese: 招募光辉守卫:每位成员都将获得一个光辉守卫单位,且训练他们的国教要求予以豁免。

english: Diplomatic Victory for the Dark Magistrate
chinese: 黑暗魔导官的外交胜利

english: As Primus Inter Pares, you can choose a Resolution to put forward for a vote.
chinese: 作为首席议员，你可以选择一项决议提交表决。

english: Our arrangement bought you but a little time. I now come to collect your soul.
chinese: 我们的约定不过为你换来些许时日。如今我来收取你的灵魂。

english: Description: New alliances ignite a religious war in the mountains of Tempus Mor. [NEWLINE]Membership in the Undercouncil or Overcouncil cannot be changed. Victory requires eliminating the members of the opposing council. [NEWLINE]Requires: Into the Desert.
chinese: 描述：新的结盟在坦普斯·摩尔的群山中点燃了一场宗教战争。[NEWLINE]下议会或上议会的成员身份无法更改。胜利需要消灭对立议会的成员。[NEWLINE]需要：深入沙漠。

english: Description: Dain means to pass the trials of the Cave of Ancestors. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Special Rules: This is a dungeon adventure. You control one unit through the challenges of the scenario and if that unit dies you lose.
chinese: 描述：丹安意欲通过先祖之洞的试炼。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：这是一场地牢冒险。你操控一个单位闯过剧本中的挑战，若该单位阵亡则你失败。

english: [ICON_BULLET]The Compact allows the gods and their direct agents free reign over their own worshipers, but severely limits their interactions with the rest of Erebus. Demons bound by The Compact can move freely in hell, but cannot enter Erebus proper except in lands held by their team or by the Ashen Veil.
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]盟约允许诸神及其直属使徒对自己的信徒享有全权支配，却严格限制他们与埃瑞布斯其余地方的往来。受盟约束缚的恶魔可在地狱中自由行动，但除非在其阵营或灰烬帷幕掌控的土地上，否则无法踏入埃瑞布斯本土。

english: The %s1_civ need your help. You must lead them.
chinese: %s1_civ 需要你的帮助。你必须率领他们。

english: Description: Auric means to ascend to godhood. If Erebus is to be saved from another Age of Ice you must stop him. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Special Rules: You do not control only one civilization, but cycle through to take control of every member of your team each turn. [NEWLINE][NEWLINE]Requires: Completion of The Black Tower, The Cult, and Against the Grey.
chinese: 描述：奥里克意欲飞升成神。若要将埃瑞布斯从又一个冰之纪元中拯救出来，你必须阻止他。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]特殊规则：你不只操控一个文明，而是每回合轮流接管你阵营中的每一名成员。[NEWLINE][NEWLINE]需要：完成「黑塔」「邪教」与「对抗灰者」。

english: And now, for something completely different. . .
chinese: 现在，来点截然不同的东西。。。

english: Yes. Our troops need every advantage they can get. I never trusted our enemy's kin anyway.
chinese: 是的。我们的军队需要一切能得到的优势。反正我从来就信不过我们敌人的血亲。

english: The Mage Guilds are the Amurite Aristocracy. In most nations Royal Guards are drawn from the sons of the rich noble houses that own most of the country. The Amurites have no hereditary nobility. A few magic bloodlines may dominate, but it is illegal for those born of such lineages to ever learn who their parents are. Anyone with innate magical talent is raised by the guild, indoctrinated to believe that their own guild is the only family that deserves their loyalty. All the guilds teach their adepts to serve the nation as a whole, but most also instill a deep suspicion as to the motives of their rival guilds. Any Amurite that could be called an aristocrat must have arcane potential, and would have been trained as an adept as a child whether or not he ever advanced to become a Wizard or Archmage. Those with true talent prefer the more honorable path of a cloistered wizard, but many who would be considered gifted mages in other lands still fail the Amurite's rigorous Trials. These must find some other way to serve their Guild, and to protect their nation from less scrupulous sorcerers.
chinese: 法师公会即是阿姆莱特的贵族阶层。在多数国家，王室近卫取自拥有大半国土的富裕贵族世家的子弟。阿姆莱特没有世袭贵族。或许有几支魔法血脉占据主导，但出身此类血统者依法永远不得知晓自己的父母是谁。任何天生具备魔法才能的人都由公会抚养长大，被灌输这样的信念：唯有自己的公会才是值得效忠的家人。所有公会都教导其术士为整个国家效力，但多数也灌输对敌对公会动机的深深猜忌。任何能被称作阿姆莱特贵族的人都必定具有秘法潜质，无论他日后是否晋升为巫师或大魔法师，都会在孩提时代被训练成术士。真正有天赋者更青睐隐修巫师这条更为荣耀的道路，但许多在别国会被视为天才法师的人，仍会在阿姆莱特严苛的试炼中落败。这些人必须另寻他途来为公会效力，并保护自己的国家免遭那些不那么严守操守的术士之害。

english: Arcane Guards require the Aristocracy civic to build, and will leave you if you change civics-so don't bother building them if you plan to change government civics soon. They are very nice units if you meet the requirements, however, as they have the ability to learn any Mage-level spell and have no level requiements. Like normal Royal Guards, they can protect whole stacks against enemies with the Marksman promotion. They also start with the ability to cast Ring of Warding, to protect cities from enemy summons.
chinese: 秘法卫士需要贵族政治政策才能建造，而一旦你更改政策他们便会离你而去——因此若你打算不久后更换政府政策，就别费心去造他们了。不过，只要你满足条件，他们便是非常出色的单位，因为他们能够学会任何法师级的法术，且没有等级要求。与普通的王室近卫一样，他们能保护整支部队免遭具有神射手晋升之敌的攻击。他们还起始便能施放守护法环，以保护城市免遭敌方召唤物侵扰。
