english: [NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]Captured cities build their original civilization's units and buildings instead of the owning civilization (so a captured Elohim city would still be able to build Monks and Reliquaries)[NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]This ability does not allow the building of other civilization's heroes
chinese: [NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]被占领的城市建造其原本文明的单位与建筑，而非占领方文明的（因此一座被占领的埃洛希姆城市仍能建造武僧与圣物阁）[NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]此能力不允许建造其他文明的英雄

english: Out of a darkened shadow door[NEWLINE]Stepped a beast of unbridled horror[NEWLINE]Cloven hooves, arms of an ape[NEWLINE]Black hair, sharp horns and eyes of hate[NEWLINE]It dragged chains like a giant tail[NEWLINE]It held a hammer, hooks and nails[NEWLINE]The thing reached out and at its touch[NEWLINE]My heart collapsed, my soul was crushed[NEWLINE]It held the chains so I could see[NEWLINE]In a haunting voice it spoke to me[NEWLINE]"for pain you cause there is a price"[NEWLINE]"you pay it in the afterlife"[NEWLINE]and then the creatures work began[NEWLINE]nails in my face, hooks in my hands[NEWLINE]pierced my skin and tore my flesh[NEWLINE]Agony from which there is no rest[PARAGRAPH:3]A Balor is a True Demon, a being of great power created directly by the gods, not the result of Hell corrupting a mortal soul into a demon of the more common sort. Few mortals have any hope of ever matching the strength of even the weakest Balor, although rare exceptions may rise to the rank of Demon Lord and rule over Balors of their own. Every Balor began as an angel in the service of a god, and either followed his master's path towards corruption or rebelled to fall on his own. All of the evil gods have Balors in their service, but most serve only Agares. The King of Hope has never created a single angel or demon, but has seduced many legions of true angels to abandon Good or Neutral gods and enter his employ.
chinese: 自一道昏暗的暗影之门中[NEWLINE]踏出一头恣意肆虐的恐怖巨兽[NEWLINE]偶蹄，猿臂[NEWLINE]黑毛，利角，双眼满含憎恨[NEWLINE]它拖曳着锁链，宛如一条巨尾[NEWLINE]它握着铁锤、钩子与钉子[NEWLINE]那东西伸出手来，只一触[NEWLINE]我的心便崩塌，我的魂被碾碎[NEWLINE]它举起锁链，好让我看清[NEWLINE]用萦绕不散的嗓音对我说道[NEWLINE]「你所造之痛，皆有代价」[NEWLINE]「你将在来世偿还」[NEWLINE]随后那生物便动起手来[NEWLINE]钉子刺入我的脸，钩子扎进我的手[NEWLINE]刺穿我的皮，撕裂我的肉[NEWLINE]那是永无止息的极痛[PARAGRAPH:3]巨角炎魔乃是真正的恶魔，是由诸神直接造就的强大存在，而非地狱将凡人灵魂腐化成寻常恶魔的产物。极少有凡人能奢望比得上哪怕最弱小的巨角炎魔之力，尽管罕见的例外或许能晋升至恶魔领主之位，统御属于自己的巨角炎魔。每一头巨角炎魔最初都是侍奉某位神祇的天使，要么追随其主走向腐化，要么叛离而独自堕落。所有邪恶之神麾下都有巨角炎魔，但多数只侍奉阿加雷斯。希望之王从未创造过一个天使或恶魔，却诱使众多军团的真天使抛弃善良或中立之神，转而为他效力。

english: Balors combine the powers of a [LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_OF_THE_VEIL]Ritualist[\\LINK] with strong melee combat abilities and affinities.[NEWLINE]They be trained by the Infernals, or summoned by any unit with [LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY3]Entropy III[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]Channeling III[\\LINK] and [LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]Entropy III[\\LINK][NEWLINE]As True Demons, [LINK=PROMOTION_BOUND_BY_COMPACT]The Compact[\\LINK] forbids Balors to enter any portion of Erebus that is not already exceedingly corrupt. Those temporarily summoned by mortals can get around this limitation. [NEWLINE]There are Balors in the service of every evil god. Most were originally Angels of that god, but every Balor of Agares was originally an angel of a good of neutral god. Most Balors keep their original affinities.
chinese: 巨角炎魔兼具[LINK=UNIT_PRIEST_OF_THE_VEIL]法阵祭司[\\LINK]的力量与强大的近战能力及亲和。[NEWLINE]他们可由地狱军团训练，或由任何具备[LINK=PROMOTION_ENTROPY3]衰退 III[\\LINK]或[LINK=PROMOTION_CHANNELING3]引导 III[\\LINK]并兼具[LINK=PROMOTION_AFFINITY_ENTROPY]衰退 III[\\LINK]的单位召唤。[NEWLINE]身为真正的恶魔，[LINK=PROMOTION_BOUND_BY_COMPACT]盟约[\\LINK]禁止巨角炎魔进入埃瑞布斯中尚未极度腐化的任何区域。被凡人临时召唤者可绕过此限制。[NEWLINE]每一位邪恶之神麾下都有巨角炎魔。多数原本是该神的天使，但每一头阿加雷斯的巨角炎魔原本都是某位善良或中立之神的天使。多数巨角炎魔保留其原本的亲和。

english: [NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]The Barbarian State will end their truce if you grow 'too civilized,' but renew it if you fall behind the rest of the world again
chinese: [NEWLINE][SPACE][SPACE][ICON_BULLET]若你变得「过于文明」，蛮族国度将终止与你的休战，但若你再度落后于世界其余各国，他们会重新缔结休战

english: Runewyns are [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]Magic Immune[\\LINK], [LINK=PROMOTION_WINGED]Winged[\\LINK] [LINK=PROMOTION_ANGEL]Angels[\\LINK] that can be summoned with [LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE3]Force III[\\LINK] or upgraded from [LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIAN]Mercurian[\\LINK] [LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]Angels[\\LINK]. Either way, they receive a free promotion pick for every source of [LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]Force mana[\\LINK] their owners control. Runewyns specialize in combatting magic. They are the only summon thay can bypass the defenses of a [LINK=BUILDING_RING_OF_WARDING]Ring of Warding[\\LINK]. Even when they loose the fight, they still destroy this and every other magically-maintained building in any city they attack. They also remove all of the spell sphere promotions and all magical effects from the units they attack (except [LINK=PROMOTION_AVATAR]Avatars[\\LINK]). Runewyns are strong against [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_DISCIPLE]Disciple units[\\LINK] and very strong against [LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]Arcane units[\\LINK], targeting them in stacks of stronger units (except in cities).
chinese: 符文之灵是[LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]魔法免疫[\\LINK]、[LINK=PROMOTION_WINGED]带翼[\\LINK]的[LINK=PROMOTION_ANGEL]天使[\\LINK]，可用[LINK=PROMOTION_FORCE3]力场 III[\\LINK]召唤，或由[LINK=CIVILIZATION_MERCURIAN]天界[\\LINK][LINK=UNIT_ANGEL]天使[\\LINK]升级而来。无论哪种方式，他们都会为其拥有者所控制的每一处[LINK=BONUS_MANA_FORCE]力场能量[\\LINK]来源获得一次免费晋升选择。符文之灵专精于对抗魔法。他们是唯一能绕过[LINK=BUILDING_RING_OF_WARDING]守护法环[\\LINK]防御的召唤物。即便他们落败，仍会摧毁其攻击的任何城市中这座及所有其他以魔法维系的建筑。他们还会移除其攻击的单位身上所有法术领域晋升与所有魔法效果（[LINK=PROMOTION_AVATAR]化身[\\LINK]除外）。符文之灵克制[LINK=UNITCOMBAT_DISCIPLE]信徒单位[\\LINK]，并极为克制[LINK=UNITCOMBAT_ADEPT]秘法单位[\\LINK]，会在更强单位的部队中优先锁定它们（城市中除外）。

english: Rather than upgrading to an ordinary Mage, Amurite Adepts with enough experience may become Wizards. A Wizard has all of the abilities of a Mage, but is slightly stronger in combat and begins with a Spell Staff and an extra free promotion pick for every source of Metamagic Mana its owner controls. An Adept still has to be at least 3rd level before it can be upgraded to a Wizard.
chinese: 与其升级为普通的法师，经验足够的阿姆莱特术士可成为巫师。巫师拥有法师的一切能力，但战斗力略强，且起始便携有一柄法杖，并为其拥有者所控制的每一处超魔能量来源获得一次额外的免费晋升选择。术士仍须至少达到 3 级方可升级为巫师。

english: These fell beasts begin as ordinary animals, which [LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]The Ashen Veil[\\LINK] corrupts and empowers through an unholy ritual requiring the sacrifice of many souls upon a [LINK=BUILDING_TEMPLE_OF_THE_VEIL]Demon's Altar. [\\LINK] They have limited duration; the Entropy that empowers them will consume them too, unless they continue devouring souls through either combat or [LINK=SPELL_BEAST_FEAST]further sacrifices[\\LINK], or the Entropy that empowers them will consume them too. Beasts of Agares are especially skilled at hunting down the holy warriors of other religions, especially Paladins.
chinese: 这些凶兽起初是寻常的动物，被[LINK=RELIGION_THE_ASHEN_VEIL]灰烬帷幕[\\LINK]通过一场需在[LINK=BUILDING_TEMPLE_OF_THE_VEIL]恶魔祭坛[\\LINK]上献祭众多灵魂的邪恶仪式加以腐化并赋予其力量。它们的存续时间有限；赋予其力量的衰退之力也将吞噬它们，除非它们通过战斗或[LINK=SPELL_BEAST_FEAST]进一步的献祭[\\LINK]持续吞食灵魂。阿加雷斯之兽尤其擅长猎杀其他宗教的圣战士，尤以圣骑士为甚。

english: The woods around the Well of Shadows is protected by the Widdershins Curse, confounding the sense of direction of all who wander near. A [LINK=PROMOTION_DEASIL_CHARM]Deasil Charm[\\LINK] or [LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOWWALK]Shadowwalk[\\LINK] render one immune.
chinese: 暗影之井周围的林地受「逆时诅咒」守护，扰乱一切在近旁徘徊者的方向感。[LINK=PROMOTION_DEASIL_CHARM]顺时护符[\\LINK]或[LINK=PROMOTION_SHADOWWALK]暗影行走[\\LINK]可使人免疫。

english: A luonnotar his early 50's. He is plain, quiet, forgettable. He is immune to all magic. And has an incredible ability purge a person of all magical ability forever.
chinese: 一位年过五旬的天母审判官。他相貌平平、沉默寡言、令人过目即忘。他对一切魔法免疫，并拥有一种惊人的能力——永久剥夺一个人的全部魔法天赋。

english: The unassuming Grigori hero combined the abilities of a Luonnotar and Runewyn, and has unequaled abilities in Force Magic.
chinese: 这位不起眼的格利高里英雄兼具天母审判官与符文之灵的能力，在力场魔法上的造诣无人能及。

english: Tomb Wardens are minor Angels whom Arawn (when he was God of Life as well as Death, before Sucellus claimed the mantle that first belonged to Nemed) tasked with guarding the passages that lead out from the Netherworld into Erebus. They are responsible for guiding new souls into the bodies of unborn babes, and helping children struggle through the first years of life in a world full of deadly diseases. Most continue to fill that role under the command of Sucellus, but many shirk their duties in order to assume jobs better suited for the Dullahan. These angels are as often found near the exits of Erebus as its entrances. They guide spirits of the dead out of Erebus, lest they be abducted by demons to join the great machine or hell of left to languish in an increasing state of corruption. Wardens specialize in slaying the Undead, but prefer to strike down potential Necromancers before they can raise such abominations. Most of what mortals know of Tomb Wardens come from tales told by grave robbers who narrowly escaped with their lives.
chinese: 陵墓守卫是低阶天使，早在苏切鲁斯接过那份最初属于尼米德的神职之前——当阿劳恩尚兼掌生命与死亡二神时——便受其派遣，看守由冥界通往埃瑞布斯的通道。他们负责引领新的灵魂进入未出世婴孩的躯体，并助孩童在这个满布致命疫病的世界里熬过生命最初的几年。多数守卫如今仍在苏切鲁斯麾下延续这一职责，但也有不少人逃避本分，去揽那些更适合杜拉罕的差事。这些天使出没于埃瑞布斯出口处的次数，不亚于其入口处。他们引领亡者之魂离开埃瑞布斯，以免其被恶魔掳去充作那座宏大机器或地狱的一部分，或任其在日益加深的腐化中枯萎。守卫尤擅斩杀不死之物，却更愿在潜在的死灵法师尚未唤起此等亵渎造物之前便将其击倒。凡人对陵墓守卫所知的大半，都来自那些侥幸逃生的盗墓者口耳相传的故事。

english: Tomb Wardens are strong against the Undead, and like the Undead can emerge to punish those who rob graveyards. They are most likely to defend Graveyards on Hallowed Ground, and their appearance in such graveyards extends the duration of the Hallowing there.
chinese: 陵墓守卫克制不死单位，且一如不死之物，会现身惩罚盗掘墓地者。他们最可能守护圣化之地上的墓地，而他们在此类墓地的现身还会延长该处圣化的持续时间。

english: Created during the Age of Dragons, Djinn are strengthened by magical energy. They were Oghma's attempt to use the power of the other gods against them. Djinn are amorphous blue forms, though they usually choose to appear as humanoids, like men made of flowing water. In an environment without magic they become weak and sedentary. Their nature makes it impossible to imprison them in magical traps or bars, but in environments without magic they can be held in items as simple as tightly corked bottles.
chinese: 灯神诞生于巨龙纪元，靠魔法能量强化。他们是奥格玛借他神之力反制诸神的尝试。灯神本是无定形的蓝色形体，却通常选择以类人之姿现身，宛如以流水塑成的人。在没有魔法的环境中，他们会变得虚弱而慵懒。其本性使其无法被囚于魔法陷阱或牢栏，但在无魔法之地，哪怕只是塞紧木塞的瓶子也足以将其困住。

english: Djinn are magic-immune summons with all the powers of Archmages. They are gifted affinity in one or two random spheres, based on your effective mana supply, allowing them to cast the greater versions of the spells from those spheres. The Tower of the Elements may grant them free promotion picks based on your effective supply of Metamagic mana.
chinese: 灯神是免疫魔法的召唤物，拥有大魔法师的全部力量。他们会依据你的有效能量供给，被赋予对一到两个随机领域的亲和，从而得以施放那些领域法术的强化版本。元素之塔可依据你的超魔能量有效供给，赐予他们免费的晋升选择。

english: An Adept with enough experience may be upgraded to a mage, putting him one step closer to becoming the even more powerful archmage. This upgrade requires the unit be at least 3rd level. Mages have access to stronger spells that Adepts. More importantly, they lock their natural affinity for at least once dominion of magic. This allows even more powerful versions of the spells in those spheres and causes the unit's combat strength to scale upwards with increading supplies of that type of mana.
chinese: 经验足够的术士可升级为魔法师，从而离更为强大的大魔法师又近了一步。此项升级要求单位至少达到 3 级。魔法师能使用比术士更强的法术。更重要的是，他们会锁定自身对至少一个魔法领域的天生亲和。这使其得以施放那些领域法术的更强版本，并令单位的战斗力随该类能量供给的增加而水涨船高。

english: A player may have only 7 Archmages at once. A Mage must be at least level 7 before it can be upgraded to an Archmage. Becoming an Archmage is the highest honor most Adepts or Mages could ever imagine. Politically it means being placed over the Mage Guilds of an entire nation. To reach this rank, Archamges must demonstrate the discipline and strength of will to fully master a dominion and cast the strongest spells their affinities allow. This talent also lets Archamges learn to wield weaker versions of every other spell sphere, with enough mana and experience. If an Archmage aspires to gain new affinties, there are 3 possibilities. He can use the Tower of Necromancy to transform himself into a Lich, at level 10 or higher. He can turn to The Ashen Veil, taking on an Unholy Taint and Making a Demonic Pact to share the affinity of a Demon Lord. Lastly, he can use the Tower of Mastery and a lot of experience to let him learn affinity for any sort of mana.
chinese: 一名玩家同时最多只能拥有 7 名大魔法师。魔法师须至少达到 7 级方可升级为大魔法师。成为大魔法师是多数术士或魔法师所能想象的最高荣誉。就政治而言，这意味着被置于整个国家的法师公会之上。为达此阶，大魔法师须展现出彻底精通一个领域、并施放其亲和所允许的最强法术的纪律与意志之力。这份才能还让大魔法师得以在能量与经验足够时，学会驾驭其余每一个法术领域的较弱版本。若大魔法师志在获取新的亲和，则有三条路可走：其一，于 10 级或更高时，借死灵之塔将自己化为巫妖；其二，皈依灰烬之幕，染上邪秽之污，缔结恶魔契约以分享某位恶魔领主的亲和；其三，借精通之塔与大量经验，习得对任意一类能量的亲和。

english: Moroi are men who drink the blood of vampires. This small taste vampiric power gives them enhanced strength and speed, and a feeling of invulnerability beyond that of their still-mortal form. The Calabim often make Moroi out of those they wish to sacrifice in combat. A Moroi who serves particularly well and survives the various suicide missions on which he is sent is occasionally gifted with true vampirism. Moroi can Receive this gift while only at level 3, whereas other must wait until level 7 before earning that honor.
chinese: 莫罗伊是饮下吸血鬼之血的人。这一小口吸血鬼之力赋予他们超凡的力量与速度，以及一种超出其仍属凡躯之身的无敌之感。卡拉比姆常将那些他们意欲在战斗中牺牲的人变作莫罗伊。若某个莫罗伊效力尤为卖力、又在派他执行的种种自杀式任务中幸存下来，偶尔会获赐真正的吸血之力。莫罗伊仅需 3 级便可获此馈赠，而其他单位则须等到 7 级方能赢得这份荣誉。

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive a free Priest of your State Religion
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得一名信奉你国教的免费祭司

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive a free High Priest of your State Religion
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]获得一名信奉你国教的免费高阶祭司

english: [ICON_BULLET]Receive a free [LINK=UNITCLASS_DRAGON_FANATIC]Dragon Fanatic[\\LINK] only if led by [LINK=LEADER_CARDITH]Cardith Lorda[\\LINK] or [LINK=LEADER_TEBRYN]Tebryn Arbandi[\\LINK]
chinese: [ICON_BULLET]仅当由[LINK=LEADER_CARDITH]少年王卡迪斯·罗达[\\LINK]或[LINK=LEADER_TEBRYN]特布里恩·阿尔班第[\\LINK]统率时，才获得一名免费的[LINK=UNITCLASS_DRAGON_FANATIC]巨龙狂信徒[\\LINK]

english: [TAB]"Rifling" is the term describing the practice of putting helical grooves in the barrel of a "long gun" to impart a spin to the projectile. This spin greatly increases the bullet's accuracy at distance. [PARAGRAPH:2]Early long guns, like the Arquebus, were "smoothbores"; these lacked rifling and the bullets were significantly smaller than the barrels of the weapons. When fired, the projectile would bounce against the sides of the weapon's barrel, giving it an uncertain direction upon exiting the barrel. [PARAGRAPH:2]The Khazad began experimenting with muskets using grooved barrels and tighter-fitting projectiles halfway through of the Age of Rebirth, but mass-produced rifled muskets did not appear until the Age of Innovation after the Bannor reclaimed their old capital of Braduk the Burning and built the Foundry of Vengeance to honor Sarabride. The rifled musket was the standard infantry weapon during Matronae purges, while Cavalry officers prided themselves on their rifled pistols.
chinese: [TAB]“膛线”一词，指的是在“长管枪”的枪管内刻出螺旋凹槽、使弹丸旋转的做法。这种旋转极大地提升了子弹在远距离上的精度。[PARAGRAPH:2]早期的长管枪，如火绳枪，都是“滑膛”的；它们没有膛线，弹丸也明显小于武器的枪管。开火时，弹丸会在枪管内壁间弹跳，使其出膛方向难以捉摸。[PARAGRAPH:2]卡扎德人早在重生之纪元中期便开始试验带凹槽枪管、弹丸更为贴合的火枪，但量产的线膛火枪直到革新之纪元才出现——那是在班诺尔人夺回其焚毁的旧都布拉杜克、并为纪念萨拉布莱德而建起复仇铸场之后。在玛特罗奈的肃清期间，线膛火枪是步兵的标准武器，而骑兵军官则以自己的线膛手枪为傲。

english: All of mankind, with the dread exception of the followers of the Undertow, have always strongly resented slavery, on the grounds that no being should be completely subject to another. Oddly enough, this view has never been put forth in regard to Man's fellow animals...-Selena Yera, Elven Mystic
chinese: 全体人类——唯有暗流的信徒是可怖的例外——向来强烈憎恶奴役，其理由是：任何存在都不应彻底受制于另一者。奇怪的是，这一观点却从未被推及于人类的动物同胞身上……——精灵神秘学者塞莱娜·耶拉

english: [TAB]Only Agares knows the origin of these stones. They may be a pale reflection of the gems of creation or Agares's failed attempts to make his own. Regardless, they radiate powerful death magic and draw wraiths to them like silent beacons. During the Age of Magic necromancers were said to have turned the stones into powerful weapons for those that wielded them, but only during the Age of Rebirth were they made into weapons that could wield themselves. [PARAGRAPH]The Luchuirp shun demons such as Eidola, yet their Artificers have crafted abominations even more vile. The Enchantments that bring this golem to life also enhance the power of necromancy inherent in the material, creating soulless automata with affinity for Undeath magic. These machines have no wills of their and are not bound by the compact, yet the taint of hell remains within them and lets them summon Imps, Balors, and to channel the power of any Demon Lords with whom their masters have formed Pacts.
chinese: [TAB]唯有阿加雷斯知晓这些石头的来历。它们或许是创世宝石的苍白倒影，又或是阿加雷斯自制宝石的失败尝试。无论如何，它们散发着强大的死亡魔法，如无声的信标般引来厉鬼。据说在魔法纪元，死灵法师曾将这些石头炼成强大的武器、交予持用者，但直到重生之纪元，它们才被造成能自行挥舞自身的武器。[PARAGRAPH]鲁崔尔普人虽避忌埃多拉这类恶魔，其工造师却打造出了更为邪恶的憎恶之物。使这尊魔像活转的附魔，同时也强化了材料中固有的死灵之力，造出对不死魔法怀有亲和的无魂自动机械。这些机器没有自己的意志，也不受盟约束缚，然而地狱之污仍留驻其中，让它们得以召唤小恶魔、巨角炎魔，并引导其主人与之缔约的任何恶魔领主之力。

english: Instead of Eidola, the most evil of the Lurchirp command soulless machines whose building materials just happen to come from hell. The Compact did not anticipate Golems with powers like those of true demons, so these abominations are free to enter event Hallowed Ground. Sheut Stone Golems are harder to get than Eidola are though, as they require Sheut Stone mined from Hell terrain as well as a Sculter's Studio.
chinese: 最为邪恶的鲁崔尔普人不用埃多拉，而是役使无魂机械，其建造材料恰好来自地狱。盟约未曾料到会有力量堪比真正恶魔的魔像，因此这些憎恶之物可以自由踏入哪怕是圣化之地。不过舍乌特石魔像比埃多拉更难获得，因为它们既需要从地狱地形开采的舍乌特石，也需要一座雕塑家工坊。

english: Frydwell have all the abilities of the Horse Archers that they replace, but no longer functionally identical. These most reclusive of elves now start with [LINK=PROMOTION_FOREST_STEALTH]Forest Stealth[\\LINK] (letting them to hide in [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST]Forests[\\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]Ancient Forests[\\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]Jungles[\\LINK]. ) and [LINK=PROMOTION_SUBDUE_ANIMAL]Subdue Animal[\\LINK]. They still require [LINK=BONUS_DEER]Deer[\\LINK] instead of [LINK=BONUS_HORSE]Horses[\\LINK].
chinese: 菲德威尔拥有其所替代的马弓手的一切能力，但已不再与之如出一辙。这些最为隐世的精灵，如今起始便带有[LINK=PROMOTION_FOREST_STEALTH]森林潜行[\\LINK]（让他们得以藏身于[LINK=FEATURE_FOREST]森林[\\LINK]、[LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]远古森林[\\LINK]或[LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]丛林[\\LINK]之中。）与[LINK=PROMOTION_SUBDUE_ANIMAL]驯服野兽[\\LINK]。他们仍需要[LINK=BONUS_DEER]鹿[\\LINK]而非[LINK=BONUS_HORSE]马匹[\\LINK]。

english: Nyxkin get defensive bonuses, have no resource requirement, and can use [LINK=PROMOTION_FOREST_STEALTH]Forest Stealth[\\LINK] to hide in [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST]Forests[\\LINK], [LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]Ancient Forests[\\LINK], or [LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]Jungles[\\LINK]. They have +1 Poision damage, making them stronger than normal Horse Archers, but do not have the ranged attack ability of the unit they replace.
chinese: 豹骑兵获得防御加成，无需资源，并能借[LINK=PROMOTION_FOREST_STEALTH]森林潜行[\\LINK]藏身于[LINK=FEATURE_FOREST]森林[\\LINK]、[LINK=FEATURE_FOREST_ANCIENT]远古森林[\\LINK]或[LINK=FEATURE_JUNGLE]丛林[\\LINK]之中。他们附带 +1 毒素伤害，因而比寻常马弓手更强，但不具备其所替代单位的远程攻击能力。

english: Also called an Altar Dragon as it prefers sacrifices. They usually have a pool of blood nearby to drink from, and if their servants don't keep it filled they will usually find themselves added to it. Blood Dragons can take human form, and usually prefer to form of a dark nobleman, always with a goblet in hand. The roar of a Blood Dragon vomits up thousands of blood covered, biting, clawing, flying and venomous creatures, a torrent of creatures that are a mix between bats and scorpions. Blood Dragons maintain a collection of perfectly preserved body parts of their victims, skin, faces, organs, all displayed in a place the dragon can admire.
chinese: 血龙又称祭坛龙，因其偏爱献祭。它们身旁常备有一池鲜血可供饮用，若仆从不将其续满，往往会发现自己也被添了进去。血龙能化作人形，通常偏爱一位手中永远握着高脚酒杯的黑衣贵族之貌。血龙的一声咆哮，能吐出成千上万只沾血、撕咬、抓挠、飞舞而带毒的造物——那是一股蝙蝠与蝎子混种的洪流。血龙会收藏受害者被完好保存的身体部件——皮肤、面孔、脏器，尽数陈列于巨龙可供赏玩之处。

english: Coral dragons are not a single organism, but a collection of thousands of fist sized insect like creatures called Coralites all working together. They can separate and come back together freely. When they are together they have a breath weapon of white light that resurrects any newly dead (before their soul was collected) that it touches. Even to the point of breathing on a battlefield and raising all the fallen. Coralites occasionally get separated from their colony and have befriended humans as minor pets as they try to work out how to make it back. Coral Dragons collect precious stones, though they will occasionally leave them on the graves of those they respect.
chinese: 珊瑚龙并非单一生物，而是由成千上万只拳头大小、形似昆虫、名为珊瑚体的造物齐力构成。它们能自由分离、再重新聚合。聚合之时，它们拥有一种白光吐息为武器，可复活任何被其触及的新亡者（须在其灵魂被收走之前）——甚至能对整片战场吐息，令所有阵亡者重新站起。珊瑚体偶尔会与其群落失散，在设法归返的途中，将人类当作小宠物结为友伴。珊瑚龙收集宝石，不过偶尔会将其留在它们所敬重者的坟前。

english: These horned dragons glow with sunlight at all times, though they can control the intensity, from an angelic glow to a blinding golden light. Their breath weapon is a blast of light that burns the corrupt but won't harm the pure. Any ally touched by the light of a Dawn Drake is filled with incredible courage and hope. At dawn each day every Dawn Drake is fully healed from all injuries, mental, physical or magical and is broken free of any constraints that may hold them. They collect anything made of gold.
chinese: 这些长角的巨龙时刻散发着阳光，却能操控其强度，从天使般的柔光到令人目盲的金色强光。它们的吐息武器是一道光爆，灼烧腐坏者，却不伤纯洁之人。任何被黎明龙之光触及的盟友，都会被无与伦比的勇气与希望所充盈。每日破晓，每一条黎明龙都会从一切精神、肉体或魔法的创伤中彻底痊愈，并挣脱任何可能束缚它们的桎梏。它们收集一切以黄金制成之物。

english: The largest of the dragons, Elder Dragons tower over castles and most giants. They are typically avoided by other dragons and most lair together in one remote location, the valley of seven pines, where the gods gathered to forge the compact. These dragons met Kylorin when he came to the valley, and allowed him to take the godslayer with him when he left. He occasionally returns and spends years with the Elder Dragons. Although all dragons are immune to mortal magic, Elder Dragons are even immune to the power of the gods (this was given to them as part of the compact, that they might enforce its commands). The roar of an elder dragon fractures creation, permanently leaving fissures of nothingness in the area. Elder Dragons don't collect anything, but they have a fondness for children of all species and are typically kind to them.
chinese: 远古巨龙是体型最大的龙，高耸于城堡与多数巨人之上。它们通常为其他龙所回避，多半群居于一处偏远之地——七松之谷，昔日诸神正是聚于此地铸就盟约。这些巨龙曾在凯洛林来到谷中时与之相会，并允他离去时带走弑神者。他偶尔重返，与远古巨龙共度数年。虽说一切龙皆免疫凡间魔法，远古巨龙却连诸神之力也能免疫（这是盟约赐予它们的，好让它们得以执行盟约的号令）。远古巨龙的一声咆哮能撕裂造化，在其所在之处永久留下虚无的裂隙。远古巨龙不收集任何东西，却偏爱各族的孩童，通常待他们十分和善。

english: Also known as Fang Dragons or Lode Wyrms, these are the only flightless dragons. A Chthonic Dragon can pass through stone and are four times as heavy as it's significant size would indicate. It is quick on land, but when passing through earth it's almost instantaneous. It has no breath weapon, but it's bite easily cuts through stone and metal alike. Flesh and bone are little more than water to them. Chthonic Dragons can control a powerful magnetic field around their body, either attracting, or repulsing metal. Chthonic Dragon teeth, horns and scales are prized by enchanters and crafters. But priests of Kilmorph consider them sacred. Chthonic Dragons collect large gemstones and can be bribed for safe passage with a gem of unusual beauty.
chinese: 冥土巨龙又称尖牙龙或矿脉蠕龙，是唯一不能飞行的龙。冥土巨龙能穿石而过，其体重是其可观身形所应有的四倍。它在陆地上行动迅捷，但穿地而行时几乎是瞬息即至。它没有吐息武器，但其撕咬能轻易切穿石头与金属。血肉与骨骼于它们不过如水一般。冥土巨龙能操控其体周一片强大的磁场，随意吸引或排斥金属。冥土巨龙的牙、角与鳞为附魔师与工匠所珍视，而基尔莫芙的祭司则视其为神圣之物。冥土巨龙收集大颗宝石，一枚异常美丽的宝石便能贿赂它换取安全通行。

english: These dragons never leave the sky, they fly endlessly, usually so high above creation they have little impact on the world, or the world on them. They are the fastest of the dragons and can rush over battlefields before most will know they are there. Their breath weapon summons a great wind, from gale force winds to a tornado depending on the dragons whim. These attacks are powerful but unfocused, as likely to damage the dragon's allies as its enemies. Feathered Serpents collect light and are mesmerized by the dappled effect of sunshine through leaves, firelight, rainbows and anything that glows or glitters.
chinese: 这些龙从不离开天空，它们无休止地飞翔，通常高踞于万物造化之上，对世界几乎毫无影响，世界对它们亦然。它们是龙中最迅捷者，能在多数人察觉之前掠过战场。它们的吐息武器可召来狂风，从疾风到龙卷，全凭龙的一时兴致。这类攻击威力强大却难以聚焦，伤及盟友的概率不亚于敌人。羽蛇喜好收集光芒，会被阳光穿林洒下的斑驳光影、火光、彩虹以及一切发光闪烁之物所迷住。

english: Sometimes called Furnace or Inferno dragons. These large beasts are terrifying mixture of teeth, claws and scales. But their greatest threat is their fiery breath. It isn't just super heated flame that will melt stone and metal, but also a mucus that sticks to anything it hits and causes it to keep burning. Torch Dragon mucus is barely consumed by this and has been known to burn for days. Torch Dragon fire can also burn non-corporeal creatures like ghosts and spirits (some brave adventurers try to collect it for exactly this purpose). Unlike most dragons, Torch Dragons don't collect anything, but they are fond of beautiful music. [PARAGRAPH]Like most dragons, Torch Dragons slept through the Age of Magic, but when Bhall fell they awoke sensing that their goddess was under attack. The fury at the attack and the corruption of their dominion has led them to be very dangerous and unpredictable. They have no idea who is responsible for the pain they felt at Bhall's fall, but are ready to lash out at anyone they see in response to it.
chinese: 有时被称作熔炉龙或炼狱龙。这些庞然巨兽是利齿、尖爪与鳞甲的可怖混合体。但它们最大的威胁是那炽烈的吐息。那不只是能熔化岩石与金属的超高温火焰，还是一种黏附在任何被击中之物上、使其持续燃烧的黏液。火炬龙的黏液几乎不被火焰消耗，据说能燃烧数日之久。火炬龙的火焰甚至能烧灼幽灵与精怪这类非实体生物（一些胆大的冒险者正是为此目的试图去收集它）。与多数龙不同，火炬龙不收集任何东西，但它们钟爱优美的音乐。[PARAGRAPH]像多数龙一样，火炬龙在魔法纪元中沉睡，但当巴尔陨落时它们惊醒，感知到它们的女神正遭受攻击。攻击带来的暴怒，以及它们支配领域遭受的腐化，使它们变得极其危险且难以预测。它们不知是谁该为它们在巴尔陨落时感受到的痛苦负责，却随时准备向眼前任何人发泄这份怒火。

english: These grey giants constantly exhume a green gas that is toxic to all life. Even entering a chamber where one sleeps will kill most people. Grave Wyrms collect bones like other dragons collect gold, decorating their lairs with piles of them that would make any necromancer envious. Grave Wyrms are immortal.
chinese: 这些灰色的巨兽不断呼出一种对一切生命都有毒的绿色气体。哪怕只是踏入它沉睡的洞室，也足以杀死大多数人。墓穴巨龙收集骸骨，一如其他龙收集黄金，用堆积如山的骸骨装点自己的巢穴，令任何死灵法师艳羡。墓穴巨龙不死不灭。

english: There were only ever a few Gold Dragons created by Amathaon. They were all beautiful, unique creations, whom he viewed as his children rather than mere weapons of war. To each Amathaon gave a unique gift. To Eurabatres, his first born, the model on whom all other dragons were based, he granted the power to speak and understand all languages, including those of plants and animals, the wind, fire, earth and sea. To all he gave the ability to change form, and to breathe a gas that causes amnesia and euphoria. Victims forget their former lives so they can start anew. Gold Dragons collect items of antiquity, they don't need to be magical or valuable but they have a fascination with forgotten eras and places. A flag of a country that no longer exists, or a statue of a man once notable but now forgotten, will delight them.
chinese: 阿玛松所造的金龙从来就寥寥无几。它们个个美丽而独一无二，被他视作自己的子女，而非单纯的战争武器。阿玛松赐予每一头金龙一份独特的天赋。对尤拉巴崔斯——他的长子、此后一切龙的原型——他赐予了通晓与理解一切语言的力量，包括草木、走兽、风、火、大地与海洋之语。他赐予所有金龙变形的能力，以及呼出一种令人失忆并陷入欣快的气体。受害者会忘却前尘，从而得以重新开始。金龙收集古物，这些东西无需具有魔力或价值，但它们对被遗忘的时代与地方有着莫名的痴迷。一面早已不复存在之国度的旗帜，或一尊曾显赫一时、如今却被遗忘之人的雕像，都会令它们欣喜。

english: These glistening, black serpents looked to be fashioned from polished obsidian. They are fierce and temperamental. They love to fly at night and are swift and quiet fliers. They are thieves and collect items of high craftsmanship, from items as small as rings, to musical instruments, gravestones or statues. Anything that is beautifully made. Most assume that their glowing purple breath weapon is a disintegration beam, as that is the effect it appears to have on the target. But it's actually teleporting the target to a labyrinth within the nexus (which is almost the same as dying). Obsidian Serpents can see through all mirrors near them, and refuse to enter sanctified ground.
chinese: 这些闪亮的黑色巨蛇看似由磨光的黑曜石雕琢而成。它们凶猛而喜怒无常。它们爱在夜间飞行，飞得既迅捷又无声。它们是窃贼，收集工艺精湛之物，小至戒指，大到乐器、墓碑或雕像——只要是精美之作。多数人以为它们那道发光的紫色吐息是解离光束，因为它对目标产生的效果看似如此。但它实际上是将目标传送到枢纽之中的一座迷宫里（这与死亡几无二致）。黑曜巨蛇能看透附近的一切镜子，并拒绝踏入圣化之地。

english: Also called a Chain Dragon, Demonic Dragon, or Dragon of the Depths. These horrific creatures dwell in bottomless pits. Like all the denizens of the lowest hell, they were not created by Agares but were seduced into his service. Most were originally Torch Dragons. Agares has chained a great rock to each of them that they must drag after them. They are capable of short flight even with this rock, but it requires great labor on their part. It is uncertain if Agares did this because he enjoys tormenting the powerful creatures, if they displeased him, or if it serves some other purpose. [PARAGRAPH]The dragon exudes an aura of fear that terrifies all life, even without being seen. Though it usually ignores life outside of its pit, it is drawn to suffering. A Pit Dragon's breath weapon is a dark vapor that corrodes metal, withers flesh and crumbles stone, but has no effect on the dragons chains or the great stone it is chained to. Unlike most other dragons, Pit Dragons don't collect anything.
chinese: 又称锁链龙、恶魔龙或深渊之龙。这些恐怖的造物栖身于无底深渊之中。像最底层地狱的所有居民一样，它们并非由阿加雷斯所造，而是被诱入他的麾下。它们中的大多数原本是火炬龙。阿加雷斯给每一头都锁上一块巨石，逼它们拖着前行。即便负着这块巨石，它们仍能作短距飞行，但这需要它们付出极大的气力。尚不清楚阿加雷斯这样做，是因为他乐于折磨这些强大的造物，是它们触怒了他，还是别有他图。[PARAGRAPH]这龙散发出一种令一切生命胆寒的恐惧气场，哪怕未曾现身。虽然它通常无视深坑之外的生命，却会被苦难所吸引。深坑龙的吐息武器是一团黑暗蒸汽，能腐蚀金属、枯萎血肉、使石块崩解，却对龙身上的锁链和它所拴的那块巨石毫无作用。与其他大多数龙不同，深坑龙不收集任何东西。

english: Dragons are the greatest the weapons of the Godswar. They are all [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]immune to magic[\\LINK] and can scatter enemies in fear either by attacking or with a [LINK=SPELL_ROAR]Roar[\\LINK]. Most can [LINK=SPELL_TAKE_FLIGHT]Fly[\\LINK] and have a unique Breath weapon. Upon the signing of The Compact, most Dragons were locked away in an incorporeal realm. Some left bones as a testament to their former glory. In the Age of Rebirth, men have taken to [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]worshiping[\\LINK] the beasts in place of the gods who made them. Through the [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK] ritual, they can awaken the weapons of the gods and try to recruit them to serve in mortals' wars. The ritual allows the appropriate civilizations to directly train Abashi, Eurabatres, Drifa, and Thalatth. It allows Dragons to be resurrected from their bones, or raised as Dracoliches. Most importantly, it reveals the locations of several types of Wyrmholds. Those lairs will then start generating dragons of their associated species. [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]Dragon Fanatics[\\LINK] may visit the lairs to swear allegiance to a particular type of dragon, gaining affinity for their dominion and other promotions in the process, or may become converted to the cause of the first Dragon they hear Roar. Dragon Fanatics also have the ability to [LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]Beseech[\\LINK] a dragon to leave its lair and attack nearby enemies. The Fanatics get better results from exploring Wyrmholds, and may even recruit a dragon to join their player's control when running the Cult of the Dragon as a State Religion. [NEWLINE]The Dragons of the Depths are the least mobile dragons, as they are chained to heavy rocks at the bottom of their pits, but they are very powerful. Every Demonic Dragon once served another god before Agares corrupted it. Most retain affinity for their original spheres as well as for Entropy.
chinese: 龙是诸神之战中最强大的武器。它们全都[LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]免疫魔法[\\LINK]，能借由攻击或一声[LINK=SPELL_ROAR]咆哮[\\LINK]驱使敌人陷入恐惧四散奔逃。大多数龙能[LINK=SPELL_TAKE_FLIGHT]飞行[\\LINK]，并拥有独特的吐息武器。盟约签订之时，多数龙被封入一个无形的领域。有些留下骸骨，作为其昔日荣光的见证。在重生纪元，人类转而[LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]崇拜[\\LINK]这些巨兽，取代了造出它们的诸神。通过[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]自沉眠中唤醒[\\LINK]这一仪式，他们能唤醒诸神的武器，并试图招募它们为凡人的战争效力。该仪式使相应的文明得以直接训练阿巴什、尤拉巴崔斯、德瑞法和萨拉特。它使龙得以从骸骨中复活，或被抬升为龙巫妖。而最重要的是，它揭示了数种龙巢的所在位置。那些巢穴随后便会开始孕育其对应种类的龙。[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]巨龙狂信徒[\\LINK]可前往这些巢穴，向某一特定种类的龙宣誓效忠，在此过程中获得对其支配领域的亲和以及其他晋升，或者会皈依于他们所听闻咆哮的第一头龙的事业。巨龙狂信徒还拥有[LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]恳求[\\LINK]一头龙离开巢穴、攻击附近敌人的能力。狂信徒探索龙巢能获得更好的结果，甚至可能在以巨龙教团作为国教时招募到一头龙加入其玩家的麾下。[NEWLINE]深渊之龙是机动性最差的龙，因为它们被锁在坑底的沉重巨石上，但它们极其强大。每一头恶魔龙在被阿加雷斯腐化之前，都曾侍奉另一位神。多数龙仍保留着对其原属领域以及对衰退的亲和。

english: Sometimes called an Astral Dragon or a Ghost Dragon, they usually appear as spirits, though they can manifest physically if they desire. Rather than battle themselves Rune Dragons usually prefer to empower others to great action by binding their spirit with a host for a time. This gives the host great strength, fortitude, willpower and courage as well as the magical effects of skin as hard as a dragons hide, regeneration, immunity to hostile magic and a dramatically heightened power for any magical ability the host may already have. When physical, every scale of a Rune Dragon has been inscribed with an angelic symbol. They are long snake like dragons with wise, patient faces and can breath a silver light that destroys magic for a time. They only collect stories of the heroes they have helped and many are bound to material objects like a jeweled egg, or an ancient sword and if the need arises they make be awakened from that object to help the wielder.
chinese: 有时被称作星界龙或幽灵龙，它们通常以精怪之姿出现，但若愿意亦能实体显现。符文龙一般不亲自作战，而更喜欢暂时将自己的精魂与一名宿主结合，从而使他人成就伟业。这赋予宿主强大的力量、坚韧、意志与勇气，还有种种魔法效果：如龙皮般坚硬的肌肤、再生、免疫敌意魔法，以及使宿主原本可能已有的任何魔法能力大幅增强。当以实体现身时，符文龙的每一片鳞甲上都镌刻着一个天使符号。它们是身形颀长如蛇的龙，面容睿智而耐心，能呼出一道白银之光，暂时摧毁魔法。它们只收集自己所助过的英雄的故事，许多符文龙被束缚于诸如镶宝石的龙蛋或古剑之类的实物之中，若有需要，可从那物件里被唤醒以助持有者。

english: Also known as the father of hydras (though there is no truth to it), Seed Dragons have three heads. They have no breath weapon but each head has a different venom, one causes a paralysis, another debilitating euphoria, and the third horrific pain. They also have a poisoned stinger on the end of their tail with a venom that causes death. Seed Dragons sleep in remote forest glades, plants grow quickly over them, completely obscuring them. Their presence increases plant growth for miles around. Many thick forests have a slumbering Seed Dragon at their heart, beneath a hill of growth or nestled within the roots of a great tree, though even those walking over them would never know. Seed Dragons collect unusual plants, taking seeds and pollen carefully from new plants to bring back to their glade. [PARAGRAPH]Seed Dragons were created during the Godswar by Sucellus, but he never participated in the war. So they were given to forests and areas sacred to him, to defend against those that would wander in and destroy the forests. But since no armies attacked Sucellus they had a peaceful existence, chasing off or killing the rare isolated enemies that would wander to close. Their peaceful nature (despite their threatening appearance) survives to this day and sometimes puts them at odds with Cernunnos's more bestial nature.
chinese: 又被称作九头蛇之父（虽然此说并无实据），龙种有三个头。它们没有吐息武器，但每个头都有不同的毒液：一种引发麻痹，另一种带来使人萎靡的欣快，第三种则造成骇人的剧痛。它们的尾端还有一根淬毒的螫刺，其毒液能致死。龙种在偏远的林间空地里沉睡，草木迅速地在它们身上疯长，将它们完全遮蔽。它们的存在会使方圆数里内的植物生长加速。许多茂密的森林深处都有一头沉睡的龙种，藏在生长起来的土丘之下，或蜷伏在一株大树的根系之间，即便从它们身上走过的人也浑然不觉。龙种收集奇异的植物，会小心地从新植物上采集种子与花粉带回自己的林间空地。[PARAGRAPH]龙种是苏切鲁斯在诸神之战期间所造，但他从未参与那场战争。于是它们被安置于对他而言神圣的森林与地域，以防御那些会误入并毁坏森林的人。但由于没有军队攻击苏切鲁斯，它们过着平和的生活，只是驱逐或杀死偶尔靠得太近的零星敌人。它们平和的天性（尽管外表可怖）延续至今，有时会与科尔诺诺斯更为兽性的本性相抵触。

english: Scaled Dragons are the second largest dragon after the Elder Dragon. They can change their form, but not their mass and have been known to appear as great crocodiles or turtles, multi-headed dragons, lighthouses, great trees or small islands. They can also transform their body completely to water, and most commonly are in this form when they are underwater. Their breath weapon is a roar that can be heard for miles, and even further when issued underwater, that will bring help. This help can be from sea creatures, angels of Danalin or even the ocean itself. Scaled Dragons can instantly heal any injuries by pulling more water into their form. They collect shells and polished stones from along beaches and bring them down to their underwater lairs. A drop of their form (which appears as water), can allow anyone who drinks it to breathe water for seven days.
chinese: 鳞甲龙是仅次于始祖龙的第二大龙。它们能改变形态，却不能改变自身的质量，据说曾化作巨鳄或巨龟、多头龙、灯塔、大树或小岛。它们还能将躯体完全化为水，在水下时最常呈此形态。它们的吐息武器是一声可传数里、在水下更传得远的咆哮，能召来援助。这援助可能来自海中生物、达纳林的天使，甚至海洋本身。鳞甲龙能将更多的水吸入自身形态，从而瞬间治愈任何伤势。它们沿着海滩收集贝壳与磨光的石子，带回自己水下的巢穴。它们形态（看似为水）的一滴，能让任何饮下之人在七日之内于水中呼吸。

english: If the darkness is left to long, if centuries go by without a hint of light, it can manifest a cruel sentience. A form that swallows light and moves without sound. Shadow Dragons have two breath weapons, the first is a roar that consumes second is a dark tenebrous mass that strikes souls, driving them out of bodies and killing the victim. This leaves the husk of the body behind for just a moment before a shadow claims it, possessing the now abandoned body and using it to serve the dragon. Shadow Dragons are obsessive thieves and enjoy collecting anything that is loved by its owner and secreting it away to their lair.
chinese: 若黑暗被放任太久，若数个世纪过去而不见一丝光亮，它便能孕育出一种残忍的意识。一个吞噬光明、行动无声的形体。暗影龙有两种吐息武器：第一种是吞噬一切的咆哮，第二种是一团黑暗幽昧的物质，能击打灵魂，将其逐出躯体，杀死受害者。这会在一瞬间留下躯体的空壳，随即一道暗影便据为己有，附身于这具被弃的躯体，驱使它侍奉龙。暗影龙是执迷的窃贼，喜欢收集一切为其主人所珍爱之物，将它们秘藏到自己的巢穴。

english: Also known as Mirror dragons or Silver dragons for the reflective armor Junil has outfitted each with. Shield dragons protect a site or object and would never leave their charge. Most of these aren't holy objects of Junil, but infernal objects of great power that Junil wants to keep from getting out into creation. A Shield dragon protects the depths of Judicium. They do not need sleep, food or water. Their mouths are chained closed by Junil, and though there are rumors that their breath weapon is horrific, no one knows what it truly does. Shield dragons don't collect anything, their attention is focused on the object they guard.
chinese: 又被称作镜龙，或因尤尼尔为每一头都配上反光铠甲而被称作银龙。盾龙守护某一处所或某件物品，绝不离开自己看守之物。它们守护的大多并非尤尼尔的圣物，而是威力强大的地狱之物，尤尼尔想将其挡在造化之外。一头盾龙守护着尤迪修姆的深处。它们无需睡眠、饮食或饮水。它们的口被尤尼尔锁住，虽有传言说它们的吐息武器骇人听闻，却无人知晓它究竟有何作用。盾龙不收集任何东西，它们的注意力全然专注于所守护之物。

english: Shimmering Dragons glow with a white, prismatic light, like glowing pearl. They are beautiful, elegant creatures and occasionally change to a beautiful human form. They are fast flyers, and though they are hesitant to ever attack, they are powerful fighters when they do. Instead of a breath weapon they sing, this can range from a soothing song that puts anyone who hears it asleep, to a sonic attack that will shatter glass and eardrums and crack stone. The tear of a shimmering dragon cures disease and insanity.
chinese: 微光龙散发着白色的棱彩之光，如同发光的珍珠。它们是美丽而优雅的造物，偶尔会化作美丽的人形。它们飞行迅捷，虽然极不愿主动攻击，但一旦出手便是强大的斗士。它们不以吐息为武器，而是歌唱，其歌声从令闻者入眠的抚慰之曲，到能震碎玻璃与耳膜、使石块开裂的声波攻击，不一而足。微光龙的一滴泪能治愈疾病与疯狂。

english: These massive war machines have spikes covering their body. Dead angels are stuck on the spikes as makeshift armor. The Siege Drake can fire these spikes if it desires, but they prefer charging and impaling victims on them. Warriors of Camulos prize these fired spikes as deadly spears that can easily pierce stone and metal. The roar of the Siege Drake calls back those it has killed to fight for it, including the angels that form its armor. A Siege Drake collects the bodies of those it has killed, especially the powerful. Its lair can have thousands of corpses in it, making the effect of its roar truly terrifying.
chinese: 这些庞大的战争机器周身布满尖刺。死去的天使被刺穿挂在尖刺上，充作临时的甲胄。围城火蜥龙若愿意可将这些尖刺射出，但它们更喜欢冲锋，将受害者贯穿钉在刺上。卡穆洛斯的战士们珍视这些射出的尖刺，视其为能轻易穿透石头与金属的致命长矛。围城火蜥龙的咆哮能唤回被它杀死者为其而战，包括那些构成其甲胄的天使。围城火蜥龙收集被它杀死者的尸体，尤其是强者的。它的巢穴里可堆有成千上万具尸体，令其咆哮的效果真正令人胆寒。

english: There was little cooperation during the Godswar. Even gods of similar disposition had occasional battles with each other, though not nearly as brutal as the massive battles that shook creation between opposed gods. One of those battles happened in the Scar of Falling Stars. Kilmorph's army was there, weathered and beaten from days of battle, when an army of Camulos drew close, led by the archangel Odio, who has never been defeated in battle. There was little hope for the children of Kilmorph. [PARAGRAPH]It was in that moment that the sky filled with light. Eldritch lightning rained down on the army of Camulos. Oghma had sent his Spire Dragons to aid Kilmorph in the battle. The dragons fought bravely, the night was a hurricane of wings, roars and death. Odio fought the dragons and the army of Kilmorph at once, and in the end he killed every last dragon. There are no Spire Dragons left in creation, they all gave their lives in this battle. No dragons were ever known to mate or lay eggs, but there are rumors that a nest of Spire Dragon eggs exist. If it is so, only Oghma knows where it is. [PARAGRAPH]Though they could not beat Odio in battle, Kilmorph sent the Anchors of Creation to bind him on the battlefield. And there he remains to this day, held fast and waiting until he can return to battle. [PARAGRAPH]The worshipers of Kilmorph have little love for flying things, but occasionally in their engraving or murals there will be an image of a thin, winged dragon soaring through the sky, lightning shooting from its mouth. This is their tribute to the dragons that died to protect them and our reminder that these graceful creatures once existed.
chinese: 诸神之战期间少有协作。即便秉性相近的神祇之间也偶有争斗，虽远不及对立诸神之间那撼动造化的大战那般残酷。其中一场这样的战斗发生在陨星之痕。基尔莫芙的军队在此，经数日鏖战而疲惫伤残，此时卡穆洛斯的一支军队逼近，由从未在战斗中败北的大天使奥迪奥率领。基尔莫芙之子几乎全无胜算。[PARAGRAPH]正是在那一刻，天空布满光芒。诡秘的闪电如雨点般倾泻在卡穆洛斯的军队上。奥格玛派来了他的尖塔龙，助基尔莫芙一臂之力。群龙英勇奋战，那一夜是翅膀、咆哮与死亡的飓风。奥迪奥同时迎战群龙与基尔莫芙的军队，最终他杀死了每一头龙。造化之中再无尖塔龙存留，它们在这场战斗中全都献出了生命。从未有龙被知晓会交配或产卵，但传言有一窝尖塔龙的龙蛋存在。若真如此，也唯有奥格玛知道它在何处。[PARAGRAPH]虽然他们无法在战斗中击败奥迪奥，基尔莫芙却派出造化之锚将他缚于战场。他至今仍留在那里，被牢牢束缚，等待着能重返战斗的一天。[PARAGRAPH]基尔莫芙的信徒对会飞之物少有好感，但偶尔在他们的雕刻或壁画中，会有一头纤瘦、生翼的龙翱翔于天际、口中射出闪电的图像。这是他们向那些为守护他们而死去的龙的献礼，也是我们的一个提醒：这些优雅的造物曾经存在过。

english: Vault Wyrm's are naturally a dirty brown color, but they encrust their body with precious metals and gems that makes them look like a gilded faberge egg. They have thin bat-like wings though many have become too heavy to fly. They can breath out a billowing cloud of gas that causes delirium and hallucinations to those that breathe it, this breath does not affect dwarves. They have acute senses and can feel the lightest steps by touch, hear the sound of the air brushing against skin, and smell past generations on a person. They hate thieves and will chase one to the end of creation for a single lost coin. Clever men will doom a victim by slipping a coin from a Vault Dragon horde into their possessions.
chinese: 金库巨龙天生是一种脏兮兮的褐色，但它们用贵金属与宝石将自己的躯体镶嵌包裹，使自己看起来像一枚镀金的法贝热彩蛋。它们生有薄薄的蝙蝠状翅膀，不过许多已变得太重而无法飞行。它们能呼出一团滚滚翻腾的气体，令吸入者陷入谵妄与幻觉，这吐息对矮人无效。它们感官敏锐，能凭触觉察知最轻的脚步，听见空气拂过皮肤的声响，嗅出一个人身上数代先人的气息。它们憎恶窃贼，会为了一枚遗失的钱币将其追至造化的尽头。狡诈之人会从金库巨龙的宝藏中偷出一枚钱币，塞进受害者的财物里，从而置其于死地。

english: A blizzard always follows a Winter Wyrm, and the intensity of the blizzard grows with each Dragon in the group. Winter Wyrms can range from white to blue, with thick scales, sharp ridges along their back and a mane of grey fur. Once every 21 years Winter Wyrms awake and scour their arctic wastelands, killing anything they find. But outside of that brief time period they sleep so deeply not even attacking them will wake them and they can be killed (if you can get through their scales). Hollowmen and worshipers of Mulcarn have taken to protecting their lairs during their rest period, and hiding from them when they are awake. Winter Wyrms breath weapon is a ray of frost that is freezing cold and will put a few feet of ice on anything they breath on, usually entombing those alive that don't die to the immediate cold. Winter Wyrms collect anything that glitters, gold, gems, crystal or glass. worshipers of Mulcarn often leave elaborate ice sculptures around there lair and the dragons take care not to destroy them.
chinese: 暴风雪总是尾随冬之巨龙而来，其强度随着龙群中每多一头龙而增长。冬之巨龙的颜色可从白到蓝，鳞甲厚重，背脊布满锋利的棱脊，还生有一鬃灰色的皮毛。每隔二十一年，冬之巨龙便苏醒，横扫它们的极地荒原，见者皆杀。但在那短暂的时段之外，它们睡得极沉，即便攻击它们也无法将其惊醒，此时便可将其杀死（如果你能穿透它们的鳞甲的话）。空心人与穆尔卡恩的信徒们已习惯于在冬之巨龙休憩时守护它们的巢穴，在它们清醒时躲避它们。冬之巨龙的吐息武器是一道冰霜射线，寒冷刺骨，能在被吐息之物上覆上数尺厚的冰，通常将未被即刻的严寒冻死者活活封入冰中。冬之巨龙收集一切闪亮之物：黄金、宝石、水晶或玻璃。穆尔卡恩的信徒常在它们的巢穴周围留下精巧的冰雕，龙也会小心不去毁坏它们。

english: Dragons are the greatest the weapons of the Godswar. They are all [LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]immune to magic[\\LINK] and can scatter enemies in fear either by attacking or with a [LINK=SPELL_ROAR]Roar[\\LINK]. Most can [LINK=SPELL_TAKE_FLIGHT]Fly[\\LINK] and have a unique Breath weapon. Upon the signing of The Compact, most Dragons were locked away in an incorporeal realm. Some left bones as a testament to their former glory. In the Age of Rebirth, men have taken to [LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]worshiping[\\LINK] the beasts in place of the gods who made them. Through the [LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]Stir from Slumber[\\LINK] ritual, they can awaken the weapons of the gods and try to recruit them to serve in mortals' wars. The ritual allows the appropriate civilizations to directly train Abashi, Eurabatres, Drifa, and Thalatth. It allows Dragons to be resurrected from their bones, or raised as Dracoliches. Most importantly, it reveals the locations of several types of Wyrmholds. Those lairs will then start generating dragons of their associated species. [LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]Dragon Fanatics[\\LINK] may visit the lairs to swear allegiance to a particular type of dragon, gaining affinity for their dominion and other promotions in the process, or may become converted to the cause of the first Dragon they hear Roar. Dragon Fanatics also have the ability to [LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]Beseech[\\LINK] a dragon to leave its lair and attack nearby enemies. The Fanatics get better results from exploring Wyrmholds, and may even recruit a dragon to join their player's control when running the Cult of the Dragon as a State Religion.
chinese: 龙是诸神之战中最强大的武器。它们全都[LINK=PROMOTION_MAGIC_IMMUNE]免疫魔法[\\LINK]，能借由攻击或一声[LINK=SPELL_ROAR]咆哮[\\LINK]驱使敌人陷入恐惧四散奔逃。大多数龙能[LINK=SPELL_TAKE_FLIGHT]飞行[\\LINK]，并拥有独特的吐息武器。盟约签订之时，多数龙被封入一个无形的领域。有些留下骸骨，作为其昔日荣光的见证。在重生纪元，人类转而[LINK=RELIGION_CULT_OF_THE_DRAGON]崇拜[\\LINK]这些巨兽，取代了造出它们的诸神。通过[LINK=PROJECT_STIR_FROM_SLUMBER]自沉眠中唤醒[\\LINK]这一仪式，他们能唤醒诸神的武器，并试图招募它们为凡人的战争效力。该仪式使相应的文明得以直接训练阿巴什、尤拉巴崔斯、德瑞法和萨拉特。它使龙得以从骸骨中复活，或被抬升为龙巫妖。而最重要的是，它揭示了数种龙巢的所在位置。那些巢穴随后便会开始孕育其对应种类的龙。[LINK=UNIT_DRAGON_FANATIC]巨龙狂信徒[\\LINK]可前往这些巢穴，向某一特定种类的龙宣誓效忠，在此过程中获得对其支配领域的亲和以及其他晋升，或者会皈依于他们所听闻咆哮的第一头龙的事业。巨龙狂信徒还拥有[LINK=SPELL_BESEECH_DRAGON]恳求[\\LINK]一头龙离开巢穴、攻击附近敌人的能力。狂信徒探索龙巢能获得更好的结果，甚至可能在以巨龙教团作为国教时招募到一头龙加入其玩家的麾下。

english: A Dracolich is an Undead Dragon, the product of Necromancy used on a Dragon instead of a human corpse. Dragons do not descend from Nemed and were never blessed by all of the gods, so the range of their gifts of affinity is limited. In general a Torch Dragon's affinity is only for Fire, so it could never simply learn Necromancy. A corrupt Grave Wyrm, however, could easily turn its natural affinity for Death towards Undeath. They would not do this for immortality, like most mortal archmages who become Liches, as they are innately immortal, but simply to gain the freedom to command death on its own without any constraints from Arawn. Other dragons could be raised as undead by external sources. A dragon's immunity to mortal magic makes them harder to raise, but they could be transformed through the necromancy of an evil Grave Wyrm, a Demon Lord, an evil artifact, or a curse like that which makes everyone who dies in the Deadlands return as undead.
chinese: 龙巫妖是一种不死之龙，是将死灵法术施用于龙（而非人类尸体）的产物。龙并非源自尼米德的血脉，也从未受过所有神祇的祝福，因此它们亲和天赋的范围有限。一般而言，火炬龙的亲和只对火焰，故它绝无可能单凭自身学会死灵法术。然而一头被腐化的墓穴巨龙，却能轻易将其对死亡的天生亲和转向不死。它们这样做并非为了不朽——不像大多数化为巫妖的凡人大魔法师那样——因为它们本就生来不朽，而只是为了获得随心驾驭死亡、不受阿劳恩任何约束的自由。其他的龙也可能被外部力量抬升为不死。龙对凡人魔法的免疫使它们更难被抬升，但它们可以通过一头邪恶墓穴巨龙的死灵法术、一位恶魔领主、一件邪恶神器，或诸如使死于亡者之地者皆化为不死那样的诅咒而被转化。

english: Head of Clan Churel. Former King of the Calabim from the Age of Magic [PARAGRAPH]Churel was an ambitious and charismatic young man, adept in Spirit Magic, who became the lover of Alexis and convinced her to make him one of the first Vampires. He considered himself the King of the Calabim. For a period he and Alexis ruled their realm together. Alexis was open to sharing power with her consort, though it caused some strife with Flauros, and often allowed Churel to have his way when they disagreed. [PARAGRAPH]This lasted until Tristessa of Ashgate declared her city independent, overthrowing a weak vampire who had governed Ashgate for the Calabim. The city of Ashgate sat upon a passage to the Otherworld, for which it was named, from which the Archmage had summoned some truly horrible things to aid her revolution. The necromancer's power was such that even Alexis herself feared fighting her directly. Churel declared that Ashgate would be allowed to go free. When Alexis disagreed, Churel struck her in front of the royal court, leaving long bleeding cuts across her face. [PARAGRAPH]Alexis became a feral, raging monster. She attacked Churel and killed everyone who didn't flee from the throne room fast enough. She cursed Churel so that he could never again feed on the living, sothat he would starve to death. Then she dumped him at the edge of the Calabim empire and went off to kill every member in his clan before dealing with Tristessa. Churel lay beaten, spent and broken by the battle. [PARAGRAPH]Churel was maddeningly hungry, but unable to feed on the living. Desperate, he found that the undead had enough soul left to feed upon, without violating Alexis's curse. So he fed on ash bearers, broken men and worse. This has restored his power, but he is a corrupt dark creature, hideous in form with bending bones and a long grey body that bears little resemblance to the man he once was. [PARAGRAPH]The Calabim were quick to name his kind Graveleeches, insisting such abominations are something very different than vampires. Anyone to becomes a graveleech is forever shunned from society. [PARAGRAPH]Churel is a powerful creature; just a scratch from his claws is enough to kill. He radiates an aura of terror that few can resist. Since his curse Churel has raised some that sought him out or whom he found near death. They share his curse and are members of his exile clan. [PARAGRAPH]Most believe that Clan Churel is no more. Among the Calabim he is remembered only as the legend of what happens when Alexis is defied, but Alexis knows the catacombs that Churel haunts. When she needs him she will go command his clan's service. He is always eager to serve the queen who broke him, as he fears her far more than anyone fears him.
chinese: 丘瑞尔氏族之首。魔法纪元时代前任卡拉比姆之王[PARAGRAPH]丘瑞尔曾是个野心勃勃、魅力非凡的年轻人，精通心灵魔法，后来成了艾莉柯西丝的情人，并说服她将他变为最早的吸血鬼之一。他自视为卡拉比姆之王。有一段时间，他与艾莉柯西丝共同统治他们的国度。艾莉柯西丝乐于与她的配偶分享权力，尽管这与弗劳诺斯有些龃龉，且在两人意见相左时常允许丘瑞尔随心所欲。[PARAGRAPH]这一切一直持续到阿什盖特的特丽苔莎宣布她的城市独立，推翻了替卡拉比姆治理阿什盖特的一名孱弱吸血鬼。阿什盖特城坐落在一条通往异界的通道之上——它也因此得名——那大魔法师曾从中召唤出一些真正可怕的东西来助她革命。这死灵法师的力量之强，连艾莉柯西丝本人也惧于直接与她交手。丘瑞尔宣称应放阿什盖特自由。艾莉柯西丝不同意，丘瑞尔便当着王庭众人的面击打她，在她脸上留下长长的、血流不止的伤口。[PARAGRAPH]艾莉柯西丝化作一头狂暴嗜血的怪物。她攻击丘瑞尔，杀死了所有逃离王座厅不够快的人。她诅咒丘瑞尔，使他再也无法以活人为食，从而将活活饿死。然后她将他丢弃在卡拉比姆帝国的边缘，动身去杀光他氏族的每一个成员，之后才去对付特丽苔莎。丘瑞尔倒卧在地，被这场战斗打得遍体鳞伤、力竭而残破。[PARAGRAPH]丘瑞尔饥饿得发狂，却无法以活人为食。走投无路之下，他发现不死之物残留的魂魄足以供他吸食，而不违背艾莉柯西丝的诅咒。于是他以灰烬承负者、残破之人以及更不堪者为食。这恢复了他的力量，但他已是一个堕落的黑暗造物，形容丑陋，骨骼弯曲，拖着长长的灰色躯体，与他昔日为人时几无相似之处。[PARAGRAPH]卡拉比姆很快将他这一类命名为掘墓水蛭，坚称这般憎恶之物是与吸血鬼截然不同的东西。任何变成掘墓水蛭的人都将永远被社会所摈弃。[PARAGRAPH]丘瑞尔是个强大的造物；仅仅被他的爪子划伤一下便足以致命。他散发出一种少有人能抵御的恐怖气场。自遭诅咒以来，丘瑞尔抬升了一些主动寻他而来、或被他在濒死之际发现的人。他们共担他的诅咒，是他流亡氏族的成员。[PARAGRAPH]大多数人相信丘瑞尔氏族已不复存在。在卡拉比姆人中，他只作为一则传说被记住——违逆艾莉柯西丝会有怎样的下场——但艾莉柯西丝知道丘瑞尔出没的那些地穴。当她需要他时，便会前去命令他氏族效力。他总是急切地侍奉这位将他打垮的女王，因为他惧怕她，远甚于任何人惧怕他。

english: [TAB]Gaelan Sedracious was a lonely, awkward child. He was most at peace while alone, wandering the rosewood around his Amurite village, sometimes getting lost for hours. His village had a small school and shrine to Oghma. Though he loved learning, he suffered horrible bullying from the other children. One morning he came early to study, hoping to avoid the other children, but they caught him. Their bullying escalated to a stoning that left him nearly dead on the school floor. [PARAGRAPH]As an adult Gaelan was the head of an arcane cult called the Circle of Gaelan. They sought knowledge and were frustrated by the warnings and limitations of the more orthodox Laeran Cord. They ignored these restrictions and began summoning spirits and demons of the Mind in order to increase their power. They summoned and bound Gowlers, Endormillon, Haegtesse, Morphores and worse in their rituals. [PARAGRAPH]Each binding gave them new knowledge, but demons of the mind always had a price. They wanted some thought or memory from their summoner. The members of the Circle were forced to pay it but Gaelan had a way to avoid the cost. He formed a memory palace in Euphoria, a construct that had a copy of every precious thought and memory he had. When the demons consumed his memories, he could recover them. [PARAGRAPH]Gaelan wasn't satisfied with the lesser demons of Mind. He knew that there were more powerful true angels, created by Mammon himself that were intended to be angels of foresight and prophecy. Tired of just being able to know everything that has been, Gaelan wanted to know everything that was to come. [PARAGRAPH]These avatars were no longer spirits of foresight; they became the Roots of Fear after Mammon's fall. They no longer had the ability to see the future, instead they only saw horror, terror and panic. And they passed these visions to creation. Their impact on creation was felt by every living thing, but to meet one in person is more than the mortal mind can comprehend. [PARAGRAPH]The last act of the Circle of Gaelan was the summoning of a Root of Fear. The demon drowned them in their own personal terror and stripped their minds of anything close to sanity. But he tortured Gaelan, burning his body and mind until there was little left and then remaking him as the Burnt Priest, a servant of Mammon. [PARAGRAPH]As the demon explored the thoughts of the husk that had been Gaelan he found the secret his mind most closely guarded: the link to his memory palace. The demon followed the link to Euphoria where he was met by Caer. [PARAGRAPH]Caer and the Root of Fear battled in Euphoria. And nightmares spread to dreamers across creation as the battle occurred. The Root of Fear wanted the contents of the memory palace, but Caer shattered the palace rather than allow the demon to take it, allowing the thoughts and memories to spread to all dreamers. [PARAGRAPH]So many dreams were touched by the memories of Gaelan that some places have become fixed in the ethereal world of Euphoria, and continue to echo in dreams from people across Creation. Most prominent are a lonely but peaceful rosewood forest and a dark village schoolhouse haunted by cruel voices. [PARAGRAPH]After his transformation, the Burnt Priest moved into a small region called the Sunken Mire. The Sunken Mire was said to be gluttonous, swallowing all who enter it who don't revere Mammon. It became a base for the worship of the Undertow. Though strange creatures occasionally came in and out of the Mire, it was little threat to the surrounding lands. [PARAGRAPH]That was, until a group of adventurers entered the Sunken Mire attempting to purge its corruption. They were killed by the Burnt Priests thralls, but the Burnt Priest was angered by the attack and sent his forces to destroy Cuantine, the Bannor village whence the adventurers came. They slaughtered every citizen of Cuantine. [PARAGRAPH]After the Burnt Priest razed Cuantine, Order soldiers chose to test the legend of the Sunken Mire. They found and fought Endormillon, Haegtesse and Trow in the Mire as well as the Burnt Priests followers. They also discovered a Vault Wyrm, though no soldier stole even a single coin from the Wyrm so it left them alone. In a short but brutal, war, the thrall army was defeated and the Burnt Priest was killed by Gil-ganthor of the First Light. It is said that his sword was forever blackened where it touched the Burnt Priests blood.
chinese: [TAB]盖伦·塞德拉修斯曾是个孤僻而笨拙的孩子。独处时他最为安宁，常在他阿姆莱特村庄周围的红木林中游荡，有时一迷路就是数个钟头。他的村庄有一所小学校和一座供奉奥格玛的神龛。尽管他热爱学习，却遭受着其他孩子可怕的欺凌。一天清晨他早早来到学校研读，希望避开其他孩子，却被他们逮住。他们的欺凌升级为一场石刑，将他打得几近死去，倒在学校的地板上。[PARAGRAPH]成年后的盖伦是一个名为盖伦之环的秘法教团之首。他们追求知识，却对更为正统的莱兰绳规的种种警告与限制深感沮丧。他们无视这些约束，开始召唤精神的精怪与恶魔以增长自己的力量。他们在仪式中召唤并束缚了嚎者、恩多米隆、海格忒斯、莫弗瑞斯以及更糟之物。[PARAGRAPH]每一次束缚都带给他们新的知识，但精神的恶魔总要索取代价。它们想从召唤者身上取走某个念头或记忆。教团成员被迫付出这代价，但盖伦有办法规避这一代价。他在欣快之境中构筑了一座记忆宫殿，一件复制了他每一个珍贵念头与记忆的造物。当恶魔吞噬他的记忆时，他便能将其寻回。[PARAGRAPH]盖伦并不满足于精神的低阶恶魔。他知道存在着更强大的真天使，由玛门亲手创造，本意是作为先见与预言的天使。盖伦厌倦了只能知晓已然发生之事，他想要知晓一切将要到来之事。[PARAGRAPH]这些化身不再是先见的精怪；在玛门陨落之后，它们成了恐惧之根。它们不再拥有洞见未来的能力，反而只看得见恐怖、惊惧与惊慌。而它们将这些景象传递给造化。它们对造化的影响为每一个活物所感受，但要亲身遭遇其一，则超出了凡人心智所能理解的范畴。[PARAGRAPH]盖伦之环的最后一次行动，是召唤一头恐惧之根。那恶魔将他们淹没在各自的切身恐怖之中，剥去了他们心智中一切近乎理智的东西。但它折磨盖伦，灼烧他的身体与心智，直到几乎所剩无几，然后将他重塑为焦身祭司，一名玛门的仆从。[PARAGRAPH]当那恶魔探查这具曾是盖伦的空壳的思绪时，它发现了他心智守护得最严密的秘密：通往他记忆宫殿的连结。那恶魔顺着连结进入欣快之境，在那里遇见了凯尔。[PARAGRAPH]凯尔与恐惧之根在欣快之境中激战。战斗进行之际，噩梦蔓延至造化各处的梦者。恐惧之根想要记忆宫殿中的内容，但凯尔宁愿击碎宫殿，也不让那恶魔将其夺走，从而使那些念头与记忆散播至所有梦者。[PARAGRAPH]如此众多的梦被盖伦的记忆所触及，以致某些地方在欣快之境这一以太世界中变得固定下来，并持续回响于造化各处之人的梦中。其中最为鲜明的，是一片孤寂却安宁的红木林，以及一座被残忍话语所萦绕的黑暗乡村校舍。[PARAGRAPH]在转化之后，焦身祭司迁入一片名为沉没泥沼的小小地域。据说沉没泥沼贪得无厌，会吞噬一切踏入其中而不敬奉玛门之人。它成了崇拜暗流的一处据点。虽然偶有奇异的造物出入泥沼，它对周围的land却几乎构不成威胁。[PARAGRAPH]直到一群冒险者进入沉没泥沼，试图清除其中的腐化。他们被焦身祭司的奴仆所杀，但焦身祭司为这次袭击而震怒，派出他的军队去摧毁库安汀——那些冒险者所来自的班诺尔村庄。他们屠杀了库安汀的每一个居民。[PARAGRAPH]在焦身祭司夷平库安汀之后，秩序的士兵们决意去验证沉没泥沼的传说。他们在泥沼中找到并战胜了恩多米隆、海格忒斯与特罗，以及焦身祭司的追随者。他们还发现了一头金库巨龙，不过没有一名士兵从巨龙那里偷走哪怕一枚钱币，所以它没有理会他们。在一场短暂却残酷的战争中，奴仆军队被击溃，焦身祭司被初光的吉尔-甘索所杀。据说他的剑在触及焦身祭司之血处，永远变作了漆黑。

english: Perpentach escapes death by transferring his mind into a younger host every few decades. He then kills the old body. But one of those bodies survived and dragged itself out of the pit of corpses it was dropped into. [PARAGRAPH]That surviving version of Perpentach wears a mask and has adopted the persona of the Red Jester. He is unwilling to go through the process to transfer his mind again, and terrified that Perpentach will discover him and come back to finish the job. [PARAGRAPH]His insanity and sadism leads him to running one of the most hidden (and sought after) underground performances in Jubilee, the Carnival of Knives. Although relatively small, with just a few acts, the artistry and cruelty are unsurpassed. The Red Jester uses mind control to force his performers (most of which are dead by the end) through shocking and beautiful displays. Such as the man who consumes himself, the failed escape, and the transforming man (who cuts himself into a bird type creature). Between performances the Red Jester prowls the back alleys of Jubilee to find and dominate new performers to replace those he lost. [PARAGRAPH:2]Perpentach[PARAGRAPH]Perpentach shuddered on the floor. He pinched his eyes shut and covered his ears in an attempt to drown out the outside world. What was going on in his mind was enough. The memories of a hundred lifetimes were pouring into him. Every memory was being recalled while the lens through which he viewed them was being reforged. He was inside a kaleidoscope of endless, tumbling, crashing scenes of joy and tragedy. [PARAGRAPH]He was Samual, an acrobat with a love of rum. Under its heady guidance he was calm and sure, dancing on wires or the backs of galloping horses with ease. But without it the world scraped against him like biting sand. In Samual's mind the world was fixed and distant, like a land across an ocean, things happened there but it was generally unchanged while he was consumed with the discomforts of his own life. [PARAGRAPH]That was a dozen lifetimes ago, another rebirth of Perpentach, another who had gone through this process and awoken as the Momus king. But Samual's thoughts and memories were included with all the others, and he still screamed for a drink. [PARAGRAPH]He was one of hundreds. One was Pau, a mute artist that had never spoken until the rebirth had unlocked his tongue. Osso, A murderer who began by avenging those who were abused, and when he ran out of victims became less picky about those he killed. Keter, a hateful underling who almost managed to assassinate Perpentach, until the Momus transferred into him before he died. Arn, a young boy prone to depression and thoughts of suicide. Vinner, A personable Foxman who always hated that the Momus rarely traveled. [PARAGRAPH]It was as the murderous Osso that he judged the weakness of fawning Keter, always taking abuse from Perpentach, crying in secret, comforting himself for years with imagined revenge while doing nothing about it. As Vinner he pitied the sullen Arn as family and few friends attempted to offer encouragement but eventually faded to their own lives and left Arn to the gray emptiness of his own. [PARAGRAPH]He was, at the same time, a traveler with a lifetime of stories from bold adventures and a timid recluse, tormented and beaten by the world until it terrified him. He was an enthusiastic womanizer, a scandalous uranian and an asexual sadist who was only excited by causing pain. [PARAGRAPH]He waited, but the spinning in his head never stopped. Instead he grew accustomed to it. He opened his eyes and saw the dimly lit throne room. It had only been minutes since he was standing here as he couldn't remember, there were a hundred voices in his head. One was probably that of his former life, but it was buried under everything that was new. [PARAGRAPH]The first epiphany from all of these new experiences wasn't wisdom, there was no universal lessons to be learned from all of these lives. Be good and good things will come to you no. The cruel will get what they deserve in the end no. There was no path to success or happiness, just empty ideologies adopted to provide comfort. Though the world was viewed through many lives, the world stayed the same. Where some saw hope, others saw despair. Where some were richly rewarded for their efforts, others suffered regardless of their choices. Life was random. [PARAGRAPH]It was so blatantly absurd that he couldn't help but laugh. Hundreds of useless intentions, sacrifices for no reason, endless ideals. The world was full of kittens all chasing imaginary strings. [PARAGRAPH]The laughter echoed in his head. He laughed until his lungs burned in his chest, his cheeks ached and his lips split and cracked. When he finally drew himself up off the floor he was gasping for breath, still overcome with small tremors of chuckles and twitches in his face. [PARAGRAPH]There was a reward for this process, a drink, Blood God wine. A treat he only allowed himself on these days. It was a sacred pact he made with himself, and he broke frequently. But despite his transgressions he also had a drink on the days he was reborn. And it always seemed sweeter on these days, maybe because it was the first time these lips would taste it. [PARAGRAPH]There it sat on a random end table set in the throne room. A bottle and a single glass next to a large mirror. But first, some voice within his mind reminded him, he had a task to do. [PARAGRAPH]Turning he saw himself sitting on the gilded bench he was currently using as a throne. Well, what he knew himself to be. An old man with milky eyes and deep wrinkles in his face. His skin would be splotchy and discolored if not for the unevenly applied white paste all over it. His clothes were bright and new, he had just picked them out for today. The colorful harlequin's crown he normally wore was sitting beside him on the bench, leaving his thinning unruly hair poking unevenly up about his head. [PARAGRAPH]I thought the voices would go with you? the old clown said. I thought I could rest, but they are still here. I don't think it worked, I haven't changed at all. [PARAGRAPH]Really? the reborn Perpentach said as he admired himself in the mirror. He was all lean muscle and confidence. He must have had a beard because even through the white paste he also wore, he could see the bloodied cuts from shaving, some of which had reopened and bled down his face from the laughter. [PARAGRAPH]Yes, I am still Perpentach. the old clown said. [PARAGRAPH]And this made him brutally angry. He was up on the dais like a bear protecting its den. He ripped the old clown off the bench and slammed him easily onto the ground. [PARAGRAPH]Don't kill me! the old Perpentach screamed. I am you. I am Henri, and Pau and Vinner. You will be me in forty years. [PARAGRAPH]The new Perpentach stared down at the old. Had he really been that old and feeble? He thought he had been powerful, the Balseraph court catered to his every whim. But this saggy clown laying on the floor in front of him looked like an imposter in his clothes. [PARAGRAPH]He sat down the old man's chest. The old clown attempted to struggle but was too weak to do anything. He knocked his arms aside and squeezed his neck with his young, strong hands. He squeezed tighter as the old clowns face turned blue, squeezed tighter when the voices screamed for blood, squeezed tighter as he poured all of his self-loathing into his old battered body. [PARAGRAPH]Overall, it was a very cathartic experience. He regretted the fact others aren't able to kill themselves (at this thought they all laughed at poor suicidal Arn). It cleanses the palette, opening the mind to new opportunities and casts off former guilt and doubt. He reminded himself to suggest it to others who looked sad. [PARAGRAPH]And he still had his Blood God wine to look forward to. He poured it, sat in his garish bench throne and propped his feet up on the corpse that lay in front of it and wondered what this life would bring.
chinese: 普宾塔克每隔几十年便将自己的心智转移到一具更年轻的宿体中，以此逃避死亡。之后他会杀死旧的躯体。可其中一具躯体活了下来，从被丢弃的尸坑里挣扎着爬了出来。[PARAGRAPH]这个幸存下来的普宾塔克戴上了面具，扮起了「红衣弄臣」的身份。他不愿再经历一次心智转移的过程，又惶恐普宾塔克会发现他、回来把活儿做完。[PARAGRAPH]他的疯狂与虐性驱使他在朱比利经营着最隐秘（也最令人趋之若鹜）的地下演出之一——「刀刃狂欢会」。演出规模不大，只有寥寥数个节目，可其技艺与残忍无人能及。红衣弄臣用精神操控逼迫他的表演者（大多数到最后都已横死）完成一幕幕骇人而绝美的表演。譬如那个吞噬自己的人、失败的逃脱、以及那个变形之人（把自己切割成一种鸟类生物）。演出之间的空当，红衣弄臣便在朱比利的后巷里游荡，寻觅并支配新的表演者，以填补他失去的那些。[PARAGRAPH:2]普宾塔克[PARAGRAPH]普宾塔克在地板上瑟瑟发抖。他紧闭双眼、捂住耳朵，试图将外界的一切隔绝出去。他脑中所发生的一切已经够他受的了。一百段人生的记忆正倾泻入他体内。每一段记忆都被重新唤起，而他审视这些记忆所凭借的那面透镜，也正被重新锻造。他置身于一具万花筒之中，无尽翻滚、碰撞的欢愉与悲剧的场景在其中交织。[PARAGRAPH]他曾是萨缪尔，一个嗜好朗姆酒的杂技演员。在酒精那令人晕眩的引领下，他镇定而笃实，在钢丝上、在疾驰骏马的背上翩然起舞，游刃有余。可一旦没了酒，这世界便像啮咬人的沙砾般磨蹭着他。在萨缪尔的心里，世界是固定而遥远的，如同大洋彼岸的一片土地，事情在那里发生，可他被自己人生的种种不适所吞没时，那片土地却大体不变。[PARAGRAPH]那已是十几段人生以前的事了，又一次普宾塔克的重生，又一个经历了这道过程、醒来成为摩姆斯王的人。可萨缪尔的思绪与记忆连同其余的一切都被囊括进来，他仍在尖叫着讨一杯酒喝。[PARAGRAPH]他是数百人之一。其一是保，一个哑巴艺人，直到重生解开了他的舌头，此前从未开口说过话。奥索，一个杀手，起初为受虐者复仇，等到没了这样的对象，便对下手的人不再挑剔。凯特尔，一个满怀怨恨的走卒，几乎成功刺杀了普宾塔克，直到摩姆斯在他咽气前转移进了他体内。阿恩，一个动辄消沉、常生轻生之念的少年。温纳，一个和气的狐人，一向厌恶摩姆斯难得出行。[PARAGRAPH]正是作为凶残的奥索，他评判起谄媚的凯特尔之软弱——总是逆来顺受地挨普宾塔克的欺凌，暗地里哭泣，多年来靠幻想中的复仇聊以自慰，却什么也不敢做。作为温纳，他把郁郁寡欢的阿恩当家人般怜悯，家人与寥寥几个朋友曾试图给他鼓励，可终究各自回归了自己的生活，把阿恩丢给他自己那灰暗的空虚。[PARAGRAPH]他同时既是一个满腹大胆冒险故事的旅人，又是一个怯懦的隐士，被这世界折磨鞭笞得心生恐惧。他是个热衷猎艳的浪子，一个声名狼藉的娈童者，又是一个无性的虐待狂，唯有施加痛苦才能令他兴奋。[PARAGRAPH]他等待着，可脑中的旋转从未停止。相反，他渐渐习惯了它。他睁开眼，看见了那间光线昏暗的王座厅。距他站在此处不过几分钟，可他已记不清了，脑中有上百个声音。其中一个大概是他前世的声音，可它被这一切新来之物埋在了最底下。[PARAGRAPH]这一切新体验带来的第一重顿悟并非智慧，从所有这些人生中并无普世的教训可循。行善则善报临身——不。残忍者终将得到应得的报应——不。通往成功或幸福并无坦途，只有为求慰藉而奉行的空洞信条。虽以万千人生审视世界，世界却依然故我。有人看到希望，有人看到绝望。有人因努力而获厚报，有人无论如何选择都在受苦。人生是随机的。[PARAGRAPH]这荒谬得如此赤裸，他忍不住放声大笑。数百个无用的意图，毫无缘由的牺牲，无尽的理想。这世界满是追逐着虚幻毛线的小猫。[PARAGRAPH]笑声在他脑中回荡。他笑到胸中肺叶灼痛，双颊酸胀，嘴唇也裂开渗血。等他终于从地上撑起身来，已是气喘吁吁，仍不时被一阵阵轻笑与面部的抽搐所攫住。[PARAGRAPH]这道过程有一份奖赏，一杯酒，血神之酒。这是他只在这些日子里才许自己享用的犒赏。这是他与自己立下的神圣契约，而他常常违背。可尽管屡有僭越，在重生之日他也总要喝上一杯。而这酒在这些日子里似乎总是格外甘甜，或许是因为这是这双唇第一次尝到它的滋味。[PARAGRAPH]它就摆在王座厅里随意放着的一张边桌上。一瓶酒和一只酒杯，紧挨着一面大镜子。可是先别急，他脑中某个声音提醒道，他还有件差事要办。[PARAGRAPH]转过身，他看见了自己正坐在那张他眼下当作王座用的镀金长凳上。呃，是他所知的那个自己。一个老人，眼珠浑浊，满脸深深的皱纹。若不是脸上涂着一层涂抹不匀的白膏，他的皮肤本该斑驳而失色。他的衣裳鲜亮而崭新，是他刚为今天挑好的。他平日戴的那顶花花绿绿的小丑冠此刻搁在长凳上他身边，露出他那日渐稀疏、杂乱的头发在头上参差不齐地支棱着。[PARAGRAPH]我还以为那些声音会随你一起走呢？老小丑说道。我还以为我能歇一歇，可它们还在这儿。我看这没成，我一点也没变。[PARAGRAPH]是吗？重生的普宾塔克一边对镜自赏一边说。他浑身精瘦的肌肉，满是自信。他一定是留过胡子的，因为即便隔着他同样涂着的那层白膏，也能看见刮胡子留下的血口，其中几道已被那阵大笑重新扯裂，血顺着脸淌了下来。[PARAGRAPH]是的，我依然是普宾塔克。老小丑说。[PARAGRAPH]这令他勃然大怒。他冲上高台，像一头护巢的熊。他一把将老小丑从长凳上揪下来，轻而易举地把他砸向地面。[PARAGRAPH]别杀我！老普宾塔克尖叫道。我就是你啊。我是亨利，是保，是温纳。四十年后你就会变成我。[PARAGRAPH]新普宾塔克低头盯着这个老家伙。他当真曾这般衰老而孱弱？他一向以为自己强大无比，巴尔塞拉弗的宫廷对他的每一个心血来潮都百般迎合。可眼前这个瘫在地上、松松垮垮的小丑，看上去却像个穿着他衣服的冒名顶替者。[PARAGRAPH]他一屁股坐在老人的胸口。老小丑挣扎起来，却虚弱得无能为力。他把老人的胳膊拨到一边，用自己年轻有力的双手掐住他的脖子。他越掐越紧，老小丑的脸涨成青色；越掐越紧，那些声音尖叫着索血；越掐越紧，他把自己全部的自我憎恶都灌注进这具苍老残破的躯体。[PARAGRAPH]总的来说，这是一次极其宣泄的体验。他为旁人无法自我了断而感到遗憾（想到这里，他们都嘲笑起可怜的、有轻生之念的阿恩）。它涤净了味蕾，为心灵打开新的机遇之门，卸下往昔的愧疚与疑虑。他提醒自己，该把这个法子推荐给别的看上去愁苦的人。[PARAGRAPH]而且他还有他的血神之酒可以期待。他斟满酒，坐进他那俗艳的长凳王座，把脚翘在面前躺着的那具尸体上，琢磨着这一世又会带来些什么。

english: Morrigan is served by the Apostasy, an army of worshipers who intend to kill all believers of the old gods and remove any trace or memory of those religions. They are a strong fighting force, but more effective as a spy network as they have thousands of undercover members helping them to find and destroy hidden sects to the old gods.
chinese: 莫莉甘由「叛教团」侍奉，那是一支由信徒组成的大军，一心要杀尽所有旧神的信奉者，抹去那些宗教的一切痕迹与记忆。他们是一支强悍的战斗力量，但作为间谍网络更为有效，因为他们有数以千计的卧底成员协助他们寻出并摧毁那些隐秘的旧神教派。

english: Oghma is the god of knowledge, in all of its various forms. He is viewed by men as neutral because he doesn't work either to protect or curse men. Only Arawn intervenes in Erebus less. His priests have learned not to expect miracles and rarely if ever actually pray, but they serve him by protecting knowledge and assuring it is not forever lost. Most are librarians, archivists, teachers, and scholars. Many are also mages, as research into the arcane can lead to powers greater than most priests gain through faith. His religion, called the Laeran Cord, was widespread in the Age of Magic and welcome in almost every land. [PARAGRAPH]When the Age of Ice started nations fell to ruin. Survival became more important than learning. The Larean Cord retreated to their cloisters, attempting to consolidate and protect what was already known rather than seeking out new knowledge. The Doviello took particular delight in finding and burning their hidden libraries. [PARAGRAPH]The goddess Ceridwen had Oghma's archangel Embarr torn into three parts; his flesh, his mind and his soul were separated from each other and scattered across creation. The Laraen Cord dwindled to just a single Hierophant, now the high priest of his religion by default. Akharien means "the last one". A scholar with nothing but a frozen world to study, a teacher without anyone to teach. He wasn't that old. He was born during the Age of Ice, so he never saw the world outside of what he read of in the libraries books. [PARAGRAPH]In time hunting parties didn't return. Some priests went mad. Others died of starvation or age. And only he was left. When the Doviello came for him they offered him the chance to flee into the wilderness, to survive as a wolf so that one day he could hunt with them. But he threw himself on the books instead. He begged them to burn him instead of the books. He promised to tell them the stories contained within, and to teach them about the medicinal uses of the few plants that survived in the region. [PARAGRAPH]They didn't accept his offer. He was burned within his library. He was the last priest of the Laeran Cord of his Age. [PARAGRAPH]After his death the man's spirit didn't pass on to Oghma's vault. Instead he remained in the ruins of his library among the fluttering ashes of the brunt books. In death he had more power than in life and the Doviello learned to avoid the place. But others that came and slept nearby would dream of other places and other times. They would hear stories and be inspired. [PARAGRAPH]Early in the Age of Rebirth the Laeran Cord was refounded. A new Hierophant sought out this library and found its meager ruins. The only thing of value that he found within was the high priests crown, which he took to bring to the current church so that it could serve Oghma again.
chinese: 奥格玛是知识之神，掌管知识的一切形态。世人视他为中立，因为他既不庇护也不诅咒人类。唯有阿劳恩比他更少插手埃瑞布斯之事。他的祭司们已学会不去指望神迹，几乎从不祈祷，而是通过守护知识、确保其不致永远失传来侍奉他。他们大多是图书馆员、档案员、教师与学者。许多人也是魔法师，因为对秘法的钻研所能带来的力量，往往胜过多数祭司凭信仰所得。他的宗教名为「莱兰之环」，在魔法纪元广为流传，几乎在每片土地上都受欢迎。[PARAGRAPH]冰之纪元来临时，列国沦为废墟。生存变得比求知更为要紧。莱兰之环退回自己的修道院中，力图巩固并守护已知之事，而非探寻新知。多维洛人尤其乐于寻出并焚毁他们隐秘的图书馆。[PARAGRAPH]女神瑟丽德温令奥格玛的大天使恩巴尔被撕成三份；他的肉身、他的心智、他的灵魂彼此分离，散落于造物各处。莱兰之环凋零到只剩一位祭司长，如今理所当然地成了这个宗教的主教。阿卡里恩，意为「最后一人」。一个除了冰封世界之外别无可研究的学者，一个无人可教的教师。他并不算年迈。他生于冰之纪元，故而除了在图书馆藏书中所读之外，从未见过外面的世界。[PARAGRAPH]渐渐地，狩猎队伍开始有去无回。有些祭司发了疯。有些死于饥饿或年迈。最后只剩下他一人。多维洛人来找他时，曾给过他逃入荒野的机会——化作一头狼求生，以便有朝一日能与他们一同狩猎。可他却扑到了书上。他恳求他们烧死他，而不要烧书。他许诺把书中所载的故事讲给他们听，教他们那些在此地幸存下来的寥寥几种植物的药用之法。[PARAGRAPH]他们没有接受他的提议。他在自己的图书馆中被焚。他是他那个纪元莱兰之环的最后一位祭司。[PARAGRAPH]他死后，此人的灵魂并未前往奥格玛的宝库。相反，他留在了自己图书馆的废墟里，徘徊于被焚典籍那飘飞的灰烬之间。死后他反而比生前更有力量，多维洛人学会了避开此地。可是那些前来、在近旁安睡的人，却会梦见别的地方、别的时代。他们会听到故事，受到启迪。[PARAGRAPH]重生之纪元初期，莱兰之环得以重建。一位新的祭司长寻访到这座图书馆，找到了它那点微薄的废墟。他在其中找到的唯一有价值之物，便是那位主教的冠冕，他将其带回当时的教会，好让它再度侍奉奥格玛。

english: The Chainbreakers worship an evil goddess in a way that is not so evil. They believe she wants to free everyone from all forms of oppression and non-consensual relationships. They are radical abolitionists who are glad to harbor runaway slaves but prefer arming them to help them kill their masters and free their fellows.
chinese: 断链者以一种不算太邪恶的方式崇拜一位邪恶女神。他们相信她想让所有人摆脱一切形式的压迫与非自愿的关系。他们是激进的废奴主义者，乐于收留逃亡的奴隶，但更愿意武装他们，助他们杀死主人、解放同胞。

english: Chainbreakers cannot be trained by those running the Slavery civic. They will rebel against any leader who adopts Slavery. They will target Slaves first in stacks of stronger units, and will transform any slaves they capture into more Chainbreakers
chinese: 奉行「奴隶制」政策者无法训练断链者。他们会反叛任何采行「奴隶制」的领袖。在由更强单位组成的队列中，他们会优先攻击奴隶，并会将他们俘获的任何奴隶转化为更多的断链者。

english: The Emrys are Cultists of Ceridwen who thrive among the Sheaim. While the Chainbreakers' devotion to Ceridwen is often turned to noble ends (like ending slavery and overturning unjust regimes), the Emrys are utterly evil. Their only goals are gaining power and ending the world. They send missionaries to all nations with the aim of seducing talented adepts with the lure of access to forbidden knowledge and powers unseen since the fall of Patria.
chinese: 埃姆里斯众是瑟丽德温的狂信徒，在塞安人当中兴盛。断链者对瑟丽德温的虔诚往往被引向高尚的目的（如终结奴隶制、推翻不义的政权），埃姆里斯众却彻头彻尾地邪恶。他们唯一的目标便是攫取力量、终结世界。他们向各国派遣传教士，意在以接触禁忌知识、以及自帕特里亚陨落以来再未得见之力量为诱饵，来引诱有天赋的术士。

english: A schism occurred among the Brotherhood of Wardens when the cult spread to the Calabim. The orthodox Wardens preached Sirona's command that compassion requires taking action to defend and protect the weak. They tried to raise a rebellion, but were brutally crushed. The surviving sect still professes devotion to Sirona, but promulgated dogmas more in line with beliefs of Pelian the Suffering. Regardless of what evils their inaction might permit, they could not accept that committing violence against others is ever a lesser evil. Seeing too many problems they could not hope to fix, they gouged their own eyes out. These Blinded Brothers have dedicated themselves to providing spiritual care for the weak, in lieu of any material assistance. They mean to reduce suffering, and believe that can be best accomplished by accepting subjugation. They advise those they tend to to embrace their roles, to serve Alexis and the Calabim elite. The Blinded Brotherhood are rare but treated with some respect by all levels of Calabim society. The slaves revere them and devotedly listen to their words, even if they aren't religious. The scourge, taskmasters and middle society of the Calabim respect the Brotherhood and may seek them for words of comfort or advice (though often in secret). And the vampires often act as if they don't exist, allowing the Brotherhood to go about completely unhindered or bothered. Many suspect that when they Brotherhood took their own eyes they also took away the Vampires' ability to see them.
chinese: 当守望者兄弟会的教派传播到卡拉比姆人当中时，其内部发生了分裂。正统的守望者传扬希罗娜的诫命——慈悲要求人采取行动去捍卫、保护弱者。他们试图掀起一场叛乱，却被残酷镇压。幸存的一支仍宣称对希罗娜的虔诚，却颁布了更贴近「受苦者裴利安」信念的教条。无论他们的不作为可能纵容何等罪恶，他们都无法接受对他人施暴在任何时候会是较小的恶。眼见太多他们无望修补的问题，他们剜去了自己的双眼。这些盲眼兄弟致力于为弱者提供心灵关怀，以代替任何物质上的援助。他们意在减少苦难，并相信这最好能通过接受屈服来达成。他们劝告自己照拂之人安于其位，去侍奉艾莉柯西丝和卡拉比姆权贵。盲眼兄弟会甚为罕见，却受到卡拉比姆社会各阶层某种程度的敬重。奴隶们崇敬他们，虔诚地聆听他们的话语，哪怕他们并不信教。卡拉比姆的鞭刑者、监工与中层社会敬重兄弟会，或会求他们赐予慰藉之言或忠告（尽管常是暗地里）。而吸血鬼们则往往表现得仿佛他们并不存在，任由兄弟会全无阻碍或滋扰地行事。许多人猜想，当兄弟会剜去自己双眼时，也一并夺走了吸血鬼看见他们的能力。

english: The greatest healers in the world are to be found among the ranks of the Unblemished's Hospitallers, the priests of the Risen Sucellus. Many devote their lives to studying all the most advanced healing arts known to the Ordine Medicos, despite the fact that any placebos administered by hands that the God of Life has blessed is more effective than the best drugs devised by secular alchemists.
chinese: 世上最伟大的治疗者当属纯洁教团的医护骑士之列——他们是复生的苏切鲁斯的祭司。许多人穷尽一生钻研「医者会」所知的一切最高深的疗愈之术，尽管由生命之神所祝福的双手所施予的任何安慰剂，都比世俗炼金术士所调配的最佳药剂更为有效。

english: The High Priests of Tali can not we weighed down with such concerns as organizing any church hierarchy. Lie their god they prefer to laugh, sing, and dance upon the winds, often calling others to dance with them high in the air.
chinese: 塔利的主教们无法为组织任何教会等级之类的事务所累。他们像自己的神一样，宁愿欢笑、歌唱，在风中起舞，常常招呼旁人与他们一同高居空中共舞。

english: These high priests cannot only fly but cause all other units around them, friend and foe, to fly with them for a while as well.
chinese: 这些主教不仅能飞行，还能令周身所有其他单位——无论敌友——也随他们一同飞翔一阵。

english: Rescuers are good defenders, especially in friendly territory, and can Bless units as well as any good priests. Their special ability to Rescue Refugees can be used to move population points from oppressive rival cities (or your own cities when they are starving) to safer cities where you have more use for them. It transfers a fraction of the city's culture to experience of a Refugee unit, who can turn that experience into culture and production in the city where it settles. All Brotherhood of Wardens clerics can move freely in rival territory and carry Refugees (or other great persons) as cargo though lands you could not otherwise cross. A Devout has a cargo capacity of one, a Rescuer a capacity of three, and a Redeemer a capacity of seven.
chinese: 救援者是出色的防御者，尤其在友方领土上，且能像任何善良祭司一样为单位施「祝福」。他们「救援难民」的特殊能力，可将人口点从压迫成性的敌方城市（或你自己闹饥荒的城市）转移到你更能善加利用的、更安全的城市。它将城市的一部分文化转化为一个难民单位的经验，该单位又能在其定居的城市里将这些经验转化为文化与生产。所有守望者兄弟会的教士都能在敌方领土中自由移动，并可将难民（或其他伟人）作为货物载运，穿越你原本无法通行的土地。热忱者的载运容量为一，救援者为三，救赎者为七。

english: Arthendain will can only be trained where the Unblemished are present. He is a healer who is able to cure disease on units in the same stack and is immune to disease himself. More importantly, he targets Mary Morbus and DIseased Corpses in stacks of stronger units, and can attack such plague carriers at a distance to further reduce the risk of your units getting infected.
chinese: 阿森丹只能在纯洁教团存在之处训练。他是一名治疗者，能治愈同一队列中单位的疾病，自身也对疾病免疫。更重要的是，在由更强单位组成的队列中，他会以「伤寒玛丽」和「尸妖」为目标，并能远距离攻击这类瘟疫携带者，从而进一步降低你的单位受感染的风险。
